article_content: Quvenzhané Wallis is having a great 2014; she's again the face of Armani Junior. The 11-year-old actress models in a striped dress, playfully jumping for the camera in the advertisement. The young star has experience wearing Armani; she was in a previous ad campaign and has worn Giorgio Armani on the red carpet. Quvenzhané told the Hollywood Reporter she was honored to be an Armani ambassador, recalling her custom Oscars gown and meeting Mr. Armani. She enjoys wearing Armani Junior, calling the clothes young and cool, and joked that her friends would want to borrow them. Quvenzhané starred as Little Orphan Annie in the updated film adaptation. She discussed her role in Elle magazine. She acknowledged growing up is inevitable but expressed reluctance. Critics praise her as a leading child actor who still enjoys being a kid. She shared her approach to acting, drawing parallels with her character Annie's determination. Director Will Gluck chose her for the role over Willow Smith, seeking someone close to Annie's age, plucky, smart, and both hardened and generous. Gluck believed Quvenzhané was perfect for the part, emphasizing it wasn't about race but about a headstrong girl who cares for others. Jamie Foxx admired Quvenzhané's talent and charisma, considering her born to play the role. Quvenzhané received multiple nominations for her role, including NAACP Image Award, Critics' Choice Movie Award, and Golden Globe Award nominations. She competed with veteran actors at the Golden Globe ceremony. 'Annie' was released in US theaters in December and features other talented stars. Nicole Kidman was on the cover of the January issue of Elle magazine, which features Quvenzhané discussing her career.

article_content: David Cameron yesterday suggested he could campaign for a 'leave' vote in the EU referendum if he fails to secure significant changes to Britain’s membership terms. Seeking to address a growing crisis following a second Tory MP's defection to UKIP, the Prime Minister stated that reforms to immigration rules would be central to his plan for negotiating more flexible relationships with Brussels. Cameron expressed confidence that other EU countries would agree to concessions for the UK before the in/out referendum, including an opt-out from the EU’s principle of ‘ever closer union’. During an appearance on BBC’s Andrew Marr programme, Cameron reiterated the importance of immigration rule reforms in negotiating revised terms with Brussels. He signaled more clearly than before that he might advocate for an EU exit if his renegotiations fail – a key demand among his Eurosceptic MPs. ‘If I believed that Britain's interests were not served by being in the European Union, I would not argue for remaining,’ Cameron stated on the BBC’s Andrew Marr programme. ‘I am a deeply patriotic politician and person. I am in this role because I love my country, I care deeply about its future, and I want it to be a strong, proud, self-governing, and independent nation.’ Regarding Mark Reckless’s defection, he commented that it was ‘counterproductive and senseless’. He asserted that voters at the next election face a choice only between a Conservative and Labour government. He further stated that he would ensure reforms to freedom of movement rules – suggesting that EU citizens working in Britain could be restricted from sending child benefit abroad, for example – and that the right to work should be tied to the economic development level of their home countries. ‘If you want a European referendum, if you want immigration controlled... the only option is a Conservative government after the next election,’ Cameron said. Cameron expressed confidence that other countries would agree to concessions for the UK ahead of a referendum, including an opt-out from the European Union’s founding principle of ‘ever closer union’. Pollster Lord Ashcroft suggested Labour, under Ed Miliband, is likely to win a ‘comfortable working majority’ in 2015. The former Tory chairman indicated Labour could gain up to 37 per cent of the vote from its core supporters and defectors from the Liberal Democrats. He added that UKIP is likely to win Tory seats in Thurrock and Thanet South. A poll of 8,000 individuals indicated that over one in four Tory voters from 2010 now intend to vote for another party, with over half considering support for UKIP. Lord Ashcroft's polls indicated the Tories are behind in 24 marginal seats – potentially resulting in fewer seats than Labour. Aides clarified that the Prime Minister had not altered his stance on a referendum – but Eurosceptic MPs were convinced he had taken a stronger position. In a sign of increasing pressure on Cameron regarding Europe, former defence secretary Liam Fox warned that the Conservatives will lose the election unless they adopt a firmer stance on immigration. ‘We must develop a viable strategy on immigration within the next six months, or we will find it very difficult to win the next election,’ he stated at a fringe event. Senior Tories are also advising the Prime Minister that halting the UKIP advance by defeating Mr. Reckless in a by-election, likely delayed until November, is crucial. Her stylish dresses have often drawn attention at past conferences – but this year, Samantha Cameron appears to be favoring a more relaxed style. The Prime Minister’s wife arrived in Birmingham yesterday wearing dark corduroy trousers, a pinstriped blue shirt, and navy heels. This choice seemed unexpected for the fashion-conscious 43-year-old, but the outfit is anticipated to trigger a buying surge, known as the ‘SamCam effect’. Fashion experts have already noted the resurgence of corduroy – which was popular in the 1970s – with other notable figures, including Madonna and model Cara Delevingne, embracing the fabric.

U nastojanju da riješi sve veću krizu nakon prelaska drugog zastupnika Konzervativne stranke u UKIP, premijer je izjavio da će reforme pravila o imigraciji biti ključne u njegovom planu za pregovaranje fleksibilnijih odnosa s Bruxellesom. Cameron je izrazio uvjerenje da će se druge zemlje složiti s ustupcima za Veliku Britaniju prije referenduma, uključujući izuzeće od temeljnog načela Europske unije o ‘sve tješnjoj uniji’. Anketar Lord Ashcroft sugerirao je da će Laburistička stranka, pod vodstvom Eda Milibanda, vjerojatno osvojiti ‘udobnu radnu većinu’ 2015. Bivši predsjednik Konzervativne stranke naznačio je da bi Laburistička stranka mogla osvojiti do 37 posto glasova od svojih temeljnih pristaša i prebjega iz Liberalnih demokrata. Dodao je da će UKIP vjerojatno osvojiti mjesta Konzervativne stranke u Thurrocku i Thanetu South. Anketa provedena među 8000 ljudi pokazala je da više od četvrtine birača Konzervativne stranke iz 2010. sada namjerava glasati za drugu stranku, pri čemu više od polovice razmatra podršku UKIP-u. Ankete Lorda Ashcrofta pokazale su da Konzervativci zaostaju u 24 marginalne izborne jedinice – što bi potencijalno moglo rezultirati manjim brojem mjesta od Laburista. Pomoćnici su pojasnili da premijer nije promijenio svoj stav o referendumu – ali su euroskeptični zastupnici bili uvjereni da je zauzeo čvršći stav. Kao znak sve većeg pritiska na Camerona u vezi s Europom, bivši ministar obrane Liam Fox upozorio je da će Konzervativci izgubiti izbore ako ne zauzmu čvršći stav o imigraciji. ‘Moramo razviti održivu strategiju o imigraciji u sljedećih šest mjeseci, inače ćemo teško pobijediti na sljedećim izborima’, izjavio je na sporednom događaju. Visoki dužnosnici Konzervativne stranke također savjetuju premijeru da je zaustavljanje napredovanja UKIP-a porazom gospodina Recklessa na dopunskim izborima, koji će vjerojatno biti odgođeni do studenog, ključno. Njezine elegantne haljine često su privlačile pozornost na prošlim konferencijama – ali čini se da ove godine Samantha Cameron preferira opušteniji stil. Supruga premijera stigla je jučer u Birmingham odjevena u tamne hlače od samta, plavu prugastu košulju i mornarske štikle. Ovaj se izbor činio neočekivanim za 43-godišnjakinju koja pazi na modu, ali se očekuje da će ova kombinacija potaknuti navalu na kupnju, poznatu kao ‘SamCam efekt’. Modni stručnjaci već su primijetili povratak samta – koji je bio popularan 1970-ih – a i druge poznate osobe, uključujući Madonnu i model Caru Delevingne, prigrlile su taj materijal.

article_content: Despite his reputation as a dependable but unflashy player for Everton, Leon Osman demonstrated unexpected rapping talent at his testimonial dinner. The 33-year-old delighted guests with his version of Will Smith's 'Boom! Shake the Room' on Saturday night. Osman, who has dedicated over 14 years to Everton, was supported by figures such as Everton icon Kevin Kilbane and former player Nick Chadwick; many current team members also attended. The celebration, held at the Rum Warehouse within Liverpool's Titanic Hotel, aimed to benefit Claire House and the Make-a-Wish Foundation. Osman's testimonial match in August saw Everton draw 1-1 against Porto at Goodison Park. The experienced midfielder continues to be a key player for Everton, having made nine appearances this season; Roberto Martinez's team currently occupies ninth place in the Premier League after 10 games. Other footballers known for musical endeavors include Glenn Hoddle and Chris Waddle ('Diamond Lights'), Ian Wright ('Do the Right Thing'), Paul Gasciogne ('Geordie Boys' & 'Fog on the Tyne'), and Andy Cole ('Outstanding').

article_content: Todd and Melissa Puchalla, after deciding they no longer wanted to raise Quita, a teenager they adopted from Liberia, sought to 're-home' her by advertising her online, much like one would sell unwanted furniture. Unlike traditional adoptions, which can take months or years, Quita was placed with another family in less than 48 hours. Nicole and Calvin Eason from Westville, Illinois, contacted the Puchallas via email, expressing their interest in adopting Quita. The Puchallas, like many other adoptive parents struggling with their adopted children, attempted to find a new family through online advertisements, a practice known as 'private re-homing'. Nicole Eason wrote in an email that she believed she was 'awesome with kids.' Mrs. Puchalla felt that the Easons 'seemed wonderful' and were qualified to care for Quita, based on their correspondence. In October 2008, the Puchallas drove from their Wisconsin home to the Easons' residence in Illinois and left Quita at their mobile home. Quita's case is one of many uncovered by Reuters and NBC News in their investigation into 'private re-homing.' The term, originally used for finding new homes for pets, now includes re-homing humans due to the similar nature of online advertisements. However, humans are not animals, and placing them with strangers can expose them to abuse. Child welfare authorities had previously removed Nicole Eason's biological children, and a sheriff's deputy described her and her husband as having 'severe psychiatric problems' and 'violent tendencies.' Nicole Eason denies that her children were taken away, claiming they still live with her, which authorities dispute. She had also adopted children online on at least six prior occasions. In 2006, Nicole Eason and Randy Winslow adopted a 10-year-old boy online. Winslow was later arrested for child pornography offenses and is serving a 20-year prison sentence. The 10-year-old boy was placed in foster care and recently turned 18; his foster parents declined an interview. On Quita's first night with the Easons, she was told to sleep in their bed, and she recalls her adoptive mother not wearing clothes. When asked about her parenting style, Nicole Eason stated, 'Dude, just be a little mean, OK? …  I’ll threaten to throw a knife at your a**, I will. I’ll chase you with a hose.' After being unable to contact the Easons for several days after dropping Quita off, Melissa Puchalla alerted authorities. They located Quita two weeks later and sent her back to Wisconsin alone on a bus. Now 21, Quita lives independently and is attending school. She thought America would be a safer place but says, 'it turned into a nightmare.' Reuters discovered numerous cases of private re-homing, finding message boards on Yahoo and Facebook dedicated to advertising adopted children. They estimate that 70% of the children offered were foreign-born adoptees from various countries, ranging from 10 months old to teenagers. Reuters analyzed 5,029 posts on one Yahoo group page over five years. One adoptive mother posted in March 2012 about her 12-year-old daughter: 'I would have given her away to a serial killer, I was so desperate.' One adopted child from China reported being forced to dig her own grave after being re-homed. A girl from Russia said she was re-homed three times in six months and, at age 13, had sex with a boy at one of the homes, who then urinated on her. Yahoo removed the pages after being notified, but a similar page continues to operate privately on Facebook. A Facebook spokesman stated that the page shows 'that the internet is a reflection of society.' The Interstate Compact on the Placement of Children (ICPC) requires families transferring custody across state lines to notify authorities in both states for vetting. However, the ICPC cannot hold parents accountable if they fail to notify them. In January 2011, an ICPC official issued a nationwide alert, stating that private re-homing online posed a 'grave danger' to children and put them 'at substantial risk.'

Nicole Eason i Randy Winslow posvojili su 10-godišnjeg dječaka online. Winslow je kasnije uhićen zbog kaznenih djela vezanih uz dječju pornografiju i služi 20-godišnju zatvorsku kaznu. Desetogodišnji dječak smješten je u udomiteljsku obitelj i nedavno je napunio 18 godina; njegovi udomitelji odbili su intervju. Prve noći s Easonovima, Quiti je rečeno da spava u njihovom krevetu, a ona se prisjeća da njena posvojiteljica nije nosila odjeću. Na pitanje o njenom stilu roditeljstva, Nicole Eason je izjavila: 'Čovječe, samo budi malo zao, OK? …  Prijetit ću da ću ti baciti nož u guzicu, hoću. Gonit ću te crijevom.' Nakon što nekoliko dana nije uspjela stupiti u kontakt s Easonovima nakon što je ostavila Quitu, Melissa Puchalla je obavijestila vlasti. Locirali su Quitu dva tjedna kasnije i poslali je natrag u Wisconsin sama autobusom. Sada 21-godišnja Quita živi samostalno i pohađa školu. Mislila je da će Amerika biti sigurnije mjesto, ali kaže: 'pretvorilo se u noćnu moru'. Reuters je otkrio brojne slučajeve privatnog ponovnog udomljavanja, pronašavši oglasne ploče na Yahoo-u i Facebooku posvećene oglašavanju posvojene djece. Procjenjuju da je 70% ponuđene djece rođeno u inozemstvu iz različitih zemalja, u dobi od 10 mjeseci do tinejdžera. Reuters je analizirao 5029 objava na jednoj Yahoo grupi tijekom pet godina. Jedno posvojeno dijete iz Kine izjavilo je da su je natjerali da iskopa vlastiti grob nakon što je bila ponovno udomljena. Djevojka iz Rusije rekla je da je bila ponovno udomljena tri puta u šest mjeseci i da je u dobi od 13 godina imala spolni odnos s dječakom u jednom od domova, koji je potom urinirao po njoj. Yahoo je uklonio stranice nakon što je obaviješten, ali slična stranica nastavlja djelovati privatno na Facebooku. Glasnogovornik Facebooka izjavio je da stranica pokazuje 'da je internet odraz društva'. Međudržavni sporazum o smještaju djece (ICPC) zahtijeva od obitelji koje prenose skrbništvo preko državnih granica da obavijeste vlasti u obje države radi provjere. article_content: Sebastian Vettel's dominant streak continued as he clinched his eighth straight victory at the U.S. Grand Prix. Adding to Red Bull's triumph, the team achieved a groundbreaking feat by executing the first-ever pit stop in under two seconds during the race on Sunday. According to the team's official website, Mark Webber's single pit stop at the Circuit of the Americas lasted a mere 1.923 seconds. The team previously celebrated their fourth successive constructors' title at the Indian Grand Prix in October, and they hailed this pit stop time as 'an incredible feat.' This new record eclipses Red Bull's prior best of 2.05 seconds, achieved at the Malaysian Grand Prix in April. That time was already a significant improvement over McLaren's 2012 record of 2.31 seconds. In April, the team hinted at further improvements, suggesting that the 'magical two-second barrier' could be broken this season. Team principal Christian Horner lauded the performance in Austin as 'an incredible team performance.' Horner commented on Vettel's new record for consecutive wins, calling it a 'fantastic performance'. He also praised Mark Webber's efforts and highlighted the team's overall achievement at the United States Grand Prix. He emphasized the significance of achieving this success in front of partners and supporters, and noted that the potential new pit stop record was the cherry on top of a great weekend.

article_content: Following the announcement of Joe Burrow's season-ending wrist injury, the Cincinnati Bengals were already staring down a difficult path toward a potential third consecutive playoff appearance. Now, without Burrow, achieving that goal looks even more improbable. The Bengals' recent 34-20 defeat against the Baltimore Ravens leaves them with a 5-5 record. As Jake Browning prepares to lead the team for the November 26 game against Pittsburgh, he takes over a squad just one game shy of a wild-card position. However, Cincinnati's conference record is a concerning 1-5, the worst in the AFC, and they haven't won any of their three divisional games. The Bengals' remaining six opponents, including two against the Steelers, all have records of .500 or better. A small amount of optimism exists given that Indianapolis, Minnesota, and Cleveland are also relying on backup quarterbacks. 'I don’t feel a heavy burden. Perhaps my view is different,' Browning told reporters on Friday. 'I think it’s detrimental to get caught up in narratives about a key player being sidelined. That's not my concern. My job is to keep improving, focusing on the day-to-day, week-to-week, and game-to-game.' 'It might sound repetitive, but your mind can wander in many directions. Concentrating solely on what’s most important—the immediate tasks—can help everything else fall into place,' Browning added. Before becoming Burrow’s backup this season, Browning spent the previous two seasons on the Bengals’ practice squad. Against the Ravens, he completed 8 of 14 passes for 68 yards, including a late-game touchdown pass in the fourth quarter. Browning was a four-year starter at the University of Washington, leading the Huskies to two Pac-12 titles. Despite this, he went undrafted and spent the 2019 and 2020 seasons on Minnesota’s practice squad. Coach Zac Taylor noted that Browning's significant training camp reps while Burrow recovered from a calf injury, along with his three seasons in Cincinnati, have been advantageous when designing the game plan. 'I’m very confident he can handle everything we ask of our players in our offensive system. So, nothing is off-limits,' Taylor said. 'The primary adjustment involves tailoring the game plan to Jake’s preferences, asking him what he feels most comfortable with in various situations, rather than asking Joe. Everything remains on the table within our offense.' OBSERVATIONS: Browning demonstrated agility under pressure. While sacked three times, he also gained 40 rushing yards on four scrambles, converting two into first downs. CONCERNS: Logan Wilson's reputation is under fire. Some Ravens players and coach John Harbaugh criticized Wilson following a hip-drop tackle on Mark Andrews during the game's opening drive. Andrews sustained a season-ending ankle injury on the play, also fumbling the ball which Wilson then recovered at the Bengals' 4-yard line. Taylor defended Wilson on Friday, saying, 'The current narrative is reckless. He plays fairly. People have jumped to conclusions and unfairly labeled him. It’s frustrating to witness. I know his character, and he plays the game properly. Player injuries are always regrettable, but I am proud to coach him and have him on our team.' PERFORMANCE BOOST: Rookie safety Jordan Battle achieved a season-high 11 tackles, including 10 solo stops, playing a season-best 57 snaps. PERFORMANCE DECLINE: Offensive tackle Orlando Brown allowed five quarterback pressures in 14 one-on-one matchups against Baltimore linebacker Odafe Oweh. NFL's Next Gen Stats indicate Brown has conceded 31 quick pressures this season, surpassing all other NFL offensive linemen. Quick pressures are defined as pressure applied within 2.5 seconds of the snap. INJURY UPDATES: Taylor had no new information on CB Cam Taylor-Britt (thigh bruise), WR Tee Higgins (hamstring), or DE Sam Hubbard (ankle), who were inactive. KEY STATISTIC: Five seasons since 2008 have seen the Bengals' starting quarterback unable to finish the season: Carson Palmer (2008), Andy Dalton (2015 and 2018), and Burrow (2020 and 2023). NEXT UP: The Bengals aim to avoid a fourth consecutive AFC North loss for the first time since 2020 when they host the Pittsburgh Steelers on November 26. ___ AP NFL: https://apnews.com/hub/NFL

Sada, bez Burrowa, ostvarenje tog cilja čini se još manje vjerojatnim. Nedavni poraz Bengalsa od Baltimore Ravensa rezultatom 34-20 ostavlja ih s omjerom 5-5. Dok se Jake Browning priprema voditi momčad u utakmici 26. studenog protiv Pittsburgha, preuzima ekipu koja je samo jednu pobjedu udaljena od mjesta za wild card. Međutim, učinak Cincinnatija u konferenciji je zabrinjavajući, 1-5, što je najgore u AFC-u, a nisu pobijedili ni u jednoj od svoje tri divizijske utakmice. Preostalih šest protivnika Bengalsa, uključujući dva susreta sa Steelersima, imaju omjer pobjeda i poraza 0.500 ili bolji. Mala doza optimizma postoji s obzirom na to da se i Indianapolis, Minnesota i Cleveland također oslanjaju na pričuvne quarterbackove. 'Ne osjećam velik pritisak. Možda ja to drugačije vidim,' izjavio je Browning novinarima u petak. 'Smatram da je kontraproduktivno opterećivati se narativima o gubitku ključnog igrača. To nije moj posao. Moj je posao nastaviti napredovati, fokusirajući se na svakodnevni rad, iz tjedna u tjedan i iz utakmice u utakmicu.' 'Možda zvuči kao ponavljanje, ali um može odlutati na različite strane. Ako se usredotočite samo na ono što je najvažnije – na trenutne zadatke – sve ostalo će sjesti na svoje mjesto,' dodao je Browning. Prije nego što je ove sezone postao Burrowova zamjena, Browning je proveo dvije sezone u trening kampu Bengalsa. Unatoč tome, nije bio izabran na draftu, te je sezone 2019. i 2020. proveo u trening kampu Minnesote. Trener Zac Taylor je istaknuo da je Browningovo iskustvo iz trening kampa, kada je Burrow bio ozlijeđen, kao i njegove tri sezone u Cincinnatiju, bilo od velike pomoći u pripremi plana igre. 'Uvjeren sam da može raditi sve što tražimo od naših igrača u našem napadačkom sustavu. Dakle, ništa nije isključeno,' rekao je Taylor. 'Glavna promjena je prilagodba plana igre Jakeovim preferencijama, pitajući njega što mu najviše odgovara u određenim situacijama, umjesto da pitamo Joea. Sve ostaje otvoreno u našem napadu.' ZAPAŽANJA: Browning je pokazao agilnost pod pritiskom. Iako je bio srušen tri puta, ostvario je i 40 jarda trčanjem u četiri navrata, pretvorivši dva u prvi down. PROBLEMI: Ugled Logana Wilsona je pod lupom. Neki igrači Ravensa i trener John Harbaugh kritizirali su Wilsona zbog 'hip-drop' prekršaja nad Markom Andrewsom tijekom prve akcije utakmice. Andrews je u toj akciji zadobio ozljedu gležnja koja je okončala njegovu sezonu, a izgubio je i loptu koju je Wilson vratio na 4 jarda Bengalsa. Taylor je u petak stao u Wilsonovu obranu, rekavši: 'Trenutni narativ je nepromišljen. On igra pošteno. Ljudi su prebrzo donijeli zaključke i nepravedno ga označili. Frustrirajuće je to gledati. Znam kakav je on i da igra pošteno. Ozljede igrača su uvijek žalosne, ali ponosan sam što ga treniram i što je dio ove momčadi.' RAST PERFORMANSI: Rookie safety Jordan Battle je ostvario rekordnih 11 tackleova, uključujući 10 solo, odigravši rekordnih 57 snapova. PAD PERFORMANSI: Offensive tackle Orlando Brown je dopustio pet pritisaka na quarterbacka u 14 duela jedan na jedan protiv linebackera Baltimorea Odafea Oweha. Prema NFL-ovoj Next Gen Stats, Brown je ove sezone dopustio 31 brzi pritisak, što je više od bilo kojeg drugog offensive linema u NFL-u. Brzi pritisci se definiraju kao pritisak na quarterbacka unutar 2,5 sekunde nakon snap-a. OZLJEDE: Taylor nije imao novih informacija o CB Camu Taylor-Brittu (ozljeda bedra), WR Tee Higginsu (ozljeda tetive) niti o DE Samu Hubbardu (ozljeda gležnja), koji nisu bili u sastavu. KLJUČNI PODATAK: U pet sezona od 2008. godine startni quarterback Bengalsa nije uspio završiti sezonu: Carson Palmer (2008), Andy Dalton (2015. i 2018.) i Burrow (2020. i 2023.). SLJEDEĆE: Bengalsi će pokušati izbjeći četvrti uzastopni poraz u AFC Northu prvi put od 2020. godine, kada 26. studenog ugoste Pittsburgh Steelerse. ___ AP NFL: https://apnews.com/hub/NFL

article_content: Nathaniel Flynn is facing a life sentence after admitting to the murder of his 84-year-old grandmother and the attempted murder of a nine-year-old boy. Flynn, 26, fatally stabbed Louisa Denby, a retired headmistress, at their shared residence in Shipley, West Yorkshire. He subsequently attempted to murder a schoolboy - whose identity is protected for legal reasons - while the boy was playing at a local skate park. Police have stated they are unaware of Flynn's motives for the 'brutal and frenzied' attacks. Julian Briggs, from the CPS Yorkshire and Humberside’s Complex Casework Unit, stated that Flynn is responsible for two 'vicious and unprovoked attacks'. Briggs added, 'It has not been possible to establish what drove Flynn to commit these awful crimes.' 'He has now admitted his responsibility and pleaded guilty to charges of murder and attempted murder. We hope this brings some measure of comfort to the families of both victims.' Flynn, from Shipley, was scheduled for trial the following week but pleaded guilty at Bradford Crown Court earlier today. Accompanied by four prison officers, Flynn, wearing a blue shirt and jeans, was joined in court by members of his family. He remained unemotional as he confessed to murdering his grandmother and stabbing the nearby schoolboy. Detective Chief Inspector Nick Wallen, of West Yorkshire Police, commented after the hearing: 'Louisa Denby was subjected to a brutal and frenzied attack at the hands of her grandson, Nathanial Flynn.' 'To this day, we still have no idea why he attacked her. Louisa was a lady, adored by her family, who had only ever shown her grandson love and kindness.' 'Having murdered his grandmother, Flynn then targeted and attacked a young boy as he played in a skateboard park.' The boy was stabbed in the arm, and police stated it was only by 'sheer luck' that the boy was not murdered by Flynn that day. 'On behalf of West Yorkshire Police, I would like to thank the people of Shipley who assisted the police to quickly detain and arrest Nathanial Flynn,' Wallen said. 'I would also like to thank all of those members of the local community who provided the police with witness statements.' Flynn is scheduled to be sentenced at Bradford Crown Court on December 18. The court also heard that Flynn faced two additional charges, which will remain on file. His mother, who resides in America, is expected to attend the sentencing. The schoolboy's father is also expected to be present. Addressing Flynn, Mr Justice Keith stated, 'There is only one sentence I can pass, and that is a sentence of life imprisonment.'

article_content: In Monaco on Thursday afternoon, as the Champions League draw unfolds, the competition will become very real for Europe's elite clubs. Stars like Toni Kroos, James Rodriguez, Xavi Hernandez, Andres Iniesta, Bastian Schweinsteiger, and Thiago Motta will be watching from training grounds across the continent. At London Colney, Jack Wilshere, fresh from Arsenal’s narrow qualifying victory over Besiktas at the Emirates, will be eager to test himself against Europe’s best midfielders. VIDEO: Jack Wilshere trains with Arsenal ahead of Besiktas clash. Time to shine: Jack Wilshere showed glimpses of brilliance against Besiktas but needs to deliver consistently this season. Arsene Wenger rightly stated that this season is pivotal for Jack Wilshere's career. It truly feels like a make-or-break moment. A year ago, Steven Gerrard's praise elevated Wilshere into the 'world class' conversation, increasing the scrutiny on him. Today, Wilshere is expected to be named alongside Calum Chambers and Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain in Roy Hodgson’s first England squad since the World Cup exit. With Gerrard and Frank Lampard retired from international duty, Wilshere has a golden opportunity to establish himself in England’s midfield. At 22, he has time to develop, but both club and country need him to step up. The Arsenal midfielder's early season form has been criticized. Much attention was given to the poolside pictures from Las Vegas, taken shortly after England’s disappointing World Cup performance. On Wednesday, without the presence of the suspended Aaron Ramsey, Wilshere displayed a certain swagger in his game. It wasn’t a complete performance, but he played a key role in the goal that secured Arsenal’s place in the Champions League group stage. He showed flashes of brilliance, evading opponents with clever movement. One notable moment was his turn in the second half, outmaneuvering Veli Kavlak and Ramon Motta before launching another attack. Deadlock: Alexis Sanchez celebrates scoring the opening goal against Besiktas. Off the mark: Sanchez scored his first goal as an Arsenal player in the 45th minute. ‘The burst is back when he gets away from players,’ Wenger noted, and it’s hard to disagree. When he does that, he can compete with anyone. His quick exchange with Mesut Ozil, which led to Arsenal’s goal and secured their 17th consecutive Champions League appearance, drew admiration from the Emirates crowd. The focus was primarily on Alexis Sanchez's first Arsenal goal, but Wilshere's contribution was significant. With Aaron Ramsey absent due to suspension, Wilshere has opportunities to shine. Hopefully, Wilshere will realize his full potential. He undoubtedly has the skill to be a key attacking force for Arsenal when they have possession. Setback: Last season's injuries hampered Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain's development. When Arsenal loses possession, his game suffers. He acknowledged fouling Besiktas winger Ramon Motta inside the area before Arsenal’s opening goal. It should have been a penalty, a clear decision for referee Pedro Proenca, but he missed it. ‘I probably touched him, but it was a slip,’ Wilshere admitted. On Wednesday night, the Arsenal midfielder had a fortunate escape. Honesty: Arsene Wenger believes it's now or never for Wilshere. VIDEO: Sanchez showed fighting spirit - Wenger.

Prvi pogodak: Sánchez je postigao svoj prvi pogodak kao igrač Arsenala u 45. minuti. ‘Vratio se prodor kad se odvoji od igrača,’ primijetio je Wenger, i teško se s tim ne složiti. Kad to učini, može se natjecati s bilo kim. Njegova brza razmjena s Mesutom Özilom, koja je dovela do Arsenalovog gola i osigurala im 17. uzastopni nastup u Ligi prvaka, izazvala je divljenje publike na Emiratesu. Fokus je prvenstveno bio na prvom golu Alexisa Sáncheza za Arsenal, ali Wilshereov doprinos je bio značajan. S obzirom na to da Aaron Ramsey nedostaje zbog suspenzije, Wilshere ima priliku zablistati. Nadamo se da će Wilshere ostvariti svoj puni potencijal. On nedvojbeno ima vještinu da bude ključna napadačka snaga za Arsenal kada imaju loptu u posjedu. Teškoća: Ozljede prošle sezone ometale su razvoj Alexa Oxlade-Chamberlaina. Kada Arsenal izgubi posjed, njegova igra pati. Priznao je da je faulirao krilnog igrača Beşiktaşa Ramona Mottu unutar šesnaesterca prije Arsenalovog prvog gola. Trebao je biti jedanaesterac, jasna odluka za suca Pedra Proencu, ali je to previdio. ‘Vjerojatno sam ga dodirnuo, ali to je bilo poskliznuće,’ priznao je Wilshere. article_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) -- A suspected U.S. drone strike resulted in the deaths of five individuals early Wednesday in Pakistan's tribal region bordering Afghanistan, according to two Pakistani intelligence officials. This marks the first drone strike since demonstrators marched to the border of Pakistan's tribal region the previous weekend to protest such attacks. The march included activists from the United States and Britain and was spearheaded by Imran Khan, a former cricket star now a politician. Opinion: Why the U.S. will live to regret drone strikes. Opinion: Could the spread of drones signal a new arms race? Four missiles were reportedly launched Wednesday at a suspected militant hideout in the Mir Ali area of North Waziristan, one of the seven districts in the volatile tribal region, the intelligence officials stated, requesting anonymity as they lacked authorization to discuss the matter with the news media. The protest march against U.S. drone strikes in Pakistan was halted on Sunday when authorities used steel shipping containers and deployed security forces to block access to the demonstration's intended destination in the tribal region. Upon encountering the roadblock, Khan instructed protesters to turn back, asserting that the march had achieved its objective of highlighting the controversial U.S. drone strikes. Read more: U.S. activists in Pakistan to protest drone strikes. Khan has been a vocal critic of U.S. policy in Pakistan and the use of drone strikes, deeming them a violation of Pakistan's sovereignty and a strategy that incites militant anger toward Washington. In recent years, the U.S. government has significantly increased the utilization of drone strikes in Pakistan's largely ungoverned tribal region, which is widely considered a safe haven for militant groups fueling the insurgency in Afghanistan. U.S. officials maintain that the drone strikes are an effective counter-terrorism strategy against militant groups and claim that civilian casualties are rare. Read more: U.S. study says drones kill, traumatize too many civilians. CNN's Reza Sayah contributed to this report.

article_content: Ryan Shawcross has been taken off man-marking duties at corners and set-pieces as Stoke City attempts to shield him from the 'grappling' spotlight. The defender was identified as a serial offender of penalty area 'dark arts' by former referee Graham Poll during the launch of the 'Hands Off In The Box' campaign. Ten days prior, Shawcross conceded a penalty after grappling with Wilfried Bony in Stoke's 2-1 victory over Swansea. However, in the 1-0 defeat at Southampton on Saturday, he was assigned zonal marking. VIDEO: Mark Hughes suggests referees are influenced by Ryan Shawcross's reputation. Ryan Shawcross conceded a penalty against Swansea after grappling with Wilfried Bony. Shawcross has now been removed from man-marking duties at corners by Stoke manager Mark Hughes. HANDS OFF IN THE BOX is a new campaign to eliminate the dark arts from the penalty box. Whether it involves wrestling, grappling, shirt pulling, or headlocks, the area has become a haven for cheating, resulting in fewer goals in the Barclays Premier League. Referees have often failed to punish players for blatantly obstructing opponents, and this campaign seeks to end that. The campaign aims to encourage players and referees to adopt a 'Hands Off In The Box' approach, promising to identify and shame both the cheats and the officials who enable them. Referee Michael Oliver's decision to penalise Shawcross appears to have had the desired deterrent effect. Stoke admits taking action due to concerns that Shawcross's reputation could make him a target for officials, even if he did nothing wrong. Stoke assistant manager Mark Bowen stated that Ryan was singled out and that the penalty, while technically correct, is a common occurrence in football. Bowen added that they attempted to remove Shawcross from the spotlight by assigning him to a zonal area during corners, a system he is not accustomed to. This change was implemented due to concerns that Shawcross was being targeted, despite being the team's captain and one of their best headers of the ball. The increasing prevalence of man-handling rivals at corners and set-pieces is damaging the game, with players often getting away with it. Chelsea players John Terry and Branislav Ivanovic were targeted by Manchester United's Marcus Rojo and Chris Smalling in a 1-1 draw at Old Trafford, with Terry complaining of being 'double headlocked'. Referee Phil Dowd took no action. Bowen defended Shawcross by highlighting other covert crimes committed in the box. The campaign aims to eliminate wrestling, grappling, man-handling, blocking, and other cheating tactics. Bowen pointed to Swansea players Bony and Ashley Williams, suggesting they should also be prevented from employing blocking tactics. Stoke defender Shawcross tussles with Southampton forward Graziano Pelle. Pelle challenges Shawcross in the air during Southampton's 1-0 win against Stoke at St Mary's. Bowen questioned whether it's just holding or the act of handing others off. He cited Swansea's blocking tactics on corners, stating it is foul play, but different clubs have different ways of gaining an advantage. Bowen admits that coaches consider sneaky fouling in the area a legitimate tactic and that it is difficult for referees to spot all infractions. Managers and coaches know that referees are unlikely to award many penalties or issue numerous yellow cards, allowing offenders to get away with it. Bowen did not deny Shawcross's foul against Bony but argued that he was unfairly singled out. Shawcross grabs the arm of Manchester City striker Edin Dzeko at the Etihad last season. Oliver's decision was sharp while Dowd may have missed the fouls. This inconsistency frustrates managers and coaches and prevents behavioral changes. Bowen believes the only way to change the mindset is by issuing red cards for every infraction, which would lead to more goals as strikers gain an advantage. Sportsmail supports the idea of fewer pushes and more goals. John Terry: 'Me and Branislav Ivanovic were double headlocked at every corner.' Colin Pascoe: 'Grappling. That is the new word is it? It is the referees' interpretation and we'll leave it to them.' Ian Wright: 'There should be an official specifically looking for holding in the box from set-pieces. It was like UFC in the United area.' Graham Poll: 'Hold or grapple and you can expect to be cautioned. Once fans, managers and players accept it as normal, this campaign will have achieved its aims.' Martin Keown: 'Defenders are checking, blocking, holding, grappling, using force to foul opponents and referees are allowing it to take place.' Micky Mellon: 'It's part of the game and some people are good at it. It's football. A local Football League referee was asking me about blocking techniques.' Readers of MailOnline: Willdajack: 'It's more infuriating because we never hear from the refs themselves. It's about time the refs were made to answer the media.' Sir Miles Platting: 'The cheating behaviour in the penalty area now is the worst I've ever seen.'

article_content: Reports indicate that a young couple tragically ended their lives by jumping in front of a train, facing pressure to dissolve their relationship. Davon Smallwood, 25, and Ariana O'Neal, 21, left behind a suicide note expressing their belief that they were headed to 'paradise' before the incident on a New York platform this past Monday. According to police sources, O'Neal, who shared a two-year-old daughter with Smallwood, had recently left home following her mother's demand that Smallwood stay away. Their landlord, Kinsley Senior, stated that Smallwood's recent legal troubles had caused concern for O'Neal's mother, who disapproved of him living with them. The couple, residing in Queens Village, had been arrested earlier in July for allegedly stealing jewelry from a Queens store and had both recently dyed their hair red. A nearby resident mentioned often seeing O'Neal lingering near the station, sometimes sitting for extended periods in a urine-soaked stairway near the platform. The suicide note was discovered on the platform by an MTA officer. Terri Simmons, another resident, said she attempted to speak with O'Neal on several occasions but received no response. The couple was struck by a train traveling at 80 mph at the Hollis station at 193rd Street and 99th Avenue. The train engineer saw them but couldn't stop in time, as reported. A witness described hearing a 'boom' upon impact. Besides the note, police found a black garbage bag containing clothing, vodka, and a can of Coca-Cola. The couple's identities were confirmed through fingerprinting, as they carried no identification.

article_content: With two days remaining before the Winter Olympics commence in Sochi, Russia, a poll indicates that over half of Americans believe a terrorist attack on the Games is probable. The CNN/ORC poll results were released a day after U.S. officials expressed specific security concerns regarding Russia. Russian state media reported on Wednesday that the suspected mastermind behind the Volgograd bombings was killed during a police operation in Dagestan, a republic in the North Caucasus. The individual was killed in a shootout at a house in Izberbash, according to Itar-Tass. The Volgograd attacks in late December, which targeted public transportation, resulted in 34 fatalities and approximately 100 injuries, raising significant security concerns in Russia. According to the CNN/ORC poll, 57% of respondents considered a terrorist attack on the Sochi Games to be likely. This is comparable to the 51% who anticipated a terrorist act before the 1996 Summer Games in Atlanta. Unfortunately, the prediction regarding the Atlanta Games proved accurate. The survey, involving over 1,000 Americans and conducted on Friday and Sunday, also revealed unfavorable opinions of Russia and President Vladimir Putin, with 54% holding a negative view of Putin, making him among the least popular foreign leaders. Currently, 55% of those surveyed have an unfavorable opinion of Russia, marking a decline from 2011, when over half of respondents viewed the country positively. This shift may be attributed to a controversial 'anti-gay propaganda' law passed last summer. Only 13% of Americans support a law similar to Russia's, which prohibits positive commentary about LGBTQ+ individuals within earshot of children, while 86% oppose it, the survey found. The gay rights advocacy group All Out is organizing events in 20 cities across 14 countries on Wednesday, urging Olympic sponsors to condemn Russia's anti-gay laws. Demonstrations are planned in cities including New York, London, and St. Petersburg, Russia. In contrast, a survey by Russia's independent Levada Center indicated that 53% of Russians believe their country made 'the right decision' in bidding to host the Sochi Olympics, RIA Novosti reported. However, only about one-third favored Russia hosting the Summer Games as well, compared to 43% who disapproved, citing concerns about corruption. The Olympic torch has arrived in Sochi, marking the culmination of a 123-day relay spanning nearly 35,000 miles (56,000 kilometers) and involving approximately 14,000 individuals. The torch was carried to the summit of Mount Elbrus, Europe's highest peak, and to the bottom of Lake Baikal, the world's largest freshwater lake in Siberia. In November, the torch was taken on its first spacewalk from Russia's Baikonur cosmodrome, with two cosmonauts carrying it (unlit) through the International Space Station and into space. Upon reaching Sochi, the torch will be used to ignite the cauldron during the opening ceremony on Friday evening. Russian authorities hope that attention will then turn to the athletic achievements of participants from around the globe. Shaun White, a U.S. medal contender and two-time Olympic gold medalist, has withdrawn from the slopestyle competition, according to the official Sochi 2014 website. The snowboarder intends to concentrate on securing a gold medal in the halfpipe competition. Slightly more than half of Americans prioritize the United States winning the most medals, according to the CNN/ORC poll. The Levada Center poll of Russians revealed that 57% anticipate the host country to rank among the top three in total medals, RIA Novosti reported. Russia has made substantial efforts to reassure athletes, officials, and spectators in Sochi regarding their safety. A 'ring of steel' has been in place around the city for nearly a month. Russian security forces have also intensified operations against suspected militants in Dagestan and other regions following the Volgograd bombings. However, skepticism persists. During a House Intelligence Committee hearing on Tuesday, National Counterterrorism Center Director Matthew Olsen voiced concern about potential attacks by Muslim fundamentalists in disputed regions of Russia or other groups. Olsen stated, 'There are a number of specific threats of varying degrees of credibility that we're tracking. And we're working very closely with the Russians and with other partners to monitor any threats we see and to disrupt those.' Austrian officials reported on Tuesday that two female members of their Winter Olympics team received a threat. Olsen identified the Caucasus Emirate (Imarat Kavkaz) as the primary threat, describing it as the most prominent terror group in Russia. 'It's made its intent clear to seek to carry out attacks in the run-up to the Games,' he said. 'We think the greater danger from a terrorist perspective is in potential for attacks to occur outside of the actual venues for the Games themselves, in the area surrounding Sochi or outside of Sochi in the region.' President Barack Obama received a briefing on U.S. efforts to bolster security in Sochi on Tuesday. 'He was assured by his team that they are taking all appropriate steps regarding the safety of Americans. He directed them to continue to work closely with the Russian government and other partners toward a secure and successful Sochi Games, and to review carefully and act on any new information that might affect the security of the Games,' according to a White House statement.

Rezultati ankete CNN/ORC objavljeni su dan nakon što su američki dužnosnici izrazili konkretnu zabrinutost za sigurnost u Rusiji. Ruski državni mediji izvijestili su u srijedu da je osumnjičeni organizator bombaških napada u Volgogradu ubijen u policijskoj operaciji u Dagestanu, republici na Sjevernom Kavkazu. Prema Itar-Tassu, osoba je ubijena u pucnjavi u kući u Izberbašu. Napadi na javni prijevoz u Volgogradu krajem prosinca rezultirali su s 34 smrtna slučaja i oko 100 ozlijeđenih, što je izazvalo veliku zabrinutost za sigurnost u Rusiji. Prema anketi CNN/ORC, 57% ispitanika smatra vjerojatnim teroristički napad na Igre u Sočiju. To je usporedivo s 51% koji su očekivali teroristički čin prije Ljetnih igara 1996. u Atlanti. Nažalost, predviđanje vezano uz Igre u Atlanti pokazalo se točnim. Anketa provedena na više od 1000 Amerikanaca u petak i nedjelju otkrila je i nepovoljna mišljenja o Rusiji i predsjedniku Vladimiru Putinu. Negativan stav o Putinu ima 54% ispitanika, što ga čini jednim od najmanje popularnih stranih lidera. Trenutno 55% ispitanih ima nepovoljno mišljenje o Rusiji, što je pad u odnosu na 2011. godinu, kada je više od polovice ispitanika imalo pozitivan stav o zemlji. Promjena bi se mogla pripisati kontroverznom zakonu o 'anti-LGBT propagandi' donesenom prošlog ljeta. Samo 13% Amerikanaca podržava zakon sličan ruskom, koji zabranjuje pozitivne komentare o LGBTQ+ osobama u prisutnosti djece, dok mu se protivi 86% ispitanika, pokazala je anketa. Organizacija za zaštitu prava LGBT osoba All Out organizira u srijedu događaje u 20 gradova u 14 zemalja, pozivajući sponzore Olimpijskih igara da osude ruske anti-LGBT zakone. Prosvjedi su planirani u gradovima poput New Yorka, Londona i Sankt Peterburga u Rusiji. Nasuprot tome, anketa neovisnog ruskog centra Levada pokazala je da 53% Rusa smatra da je njihova zemlja 'ispravno postupila' kandidirajući se za domaćina Olimpijskih igara u Sočiju, izvijestila je novinska agencija RIA Novosti. Međutim, samo je oko trećina ispitanika podržala da Rusija bude domaćin i Ljetnih igara, dok se 43% tome protivilo, navodeći zabrinutost zbog korupcije. Olimpijski plamen stigao je u Soči, čime je završena 123-dnevna štafeta duga gotovo 56.000 kilometara u kojoj je sudjelovalo oko 14.000 ljudi. Baklja je nošena na vrh Mount Elbrusa, najvišeg vrha u Europi, i na dno Bajkalskog jezera, najvećeg jezera slatke vode na svijetu u Sibiru. U studenom je baklja prvi put odnesena u svemir iz ruskog kozmodroma Bajkonur. Dva su je kozmonauta (ugašenu) nosila kroz Međunarodnu svemirsku postaju i u svemir. Po dolasku u Soči, baklja će se koristiti za paljenje olimpijskog plamena tijekom ceremonije otvaranja u petak navečer. Ruske vlasti nadaju se da će se pozornost prebaciti na sportske uspjehe sudionika iz cijelog svijeta. Prema službenoj web stranici Soči 2014, Shaun White, američki kandidat za medalju i dvostruki olimpijski pobjednik, povukao se iz natjecanja u slopestyleu. Snowboarder se želi usredotočiti na osvajanje zlatne medalje u halfpipeu. Prema anketi CNN/ORC, nešto više od polovice Amerikanaca smatra prioritetom da Sjedinjene Države osvoje najviše medalja. Anketa centra Levada među Rusima otkrila je da 57% ispitanika očekuje da će zemlja domaćin biti među prve tri po broju osvojenih medalja, izvijestila je agencija RIA Novosti. Rusija je uložila velike napore kako bi uvjerila sportaše, dužnosnike i gledatelje u Sočiju u njihovu sigurnost. 'Čelični prsten' prisutan je oko grada gotovo mjesec dana. Ruske sigurnosne snage pojačale su operacije protiv osumnjičenih militanata u Dagestanu i drugim regijama nakon bombaških napada u Volgogradu. Međutim, skepticizam i dalje postoji. Tijekom saslušanja pred Odborom za obavještajne poslove Zastupničkog doma u utorak, direktor Nacionalnog centra za borbu protiv terorizma Matthew Olsen izrazio je zabrinutost zbog mogućih napada muslimanskih fundamentalista u spornim regijama Rusije ili drugih skupina. Olsen je izjavio: 'Pratimo brojne specifične prijetnje različitog stupnja vjerodostojnosti. Vrlo blisko surađujemo s Rusima i drugim partnerima kako bismo pratili i spriječili sve prijetnje koje uočimo.' Austrijski dužnosnici izvijestili su u utorak da su dvije članice austrijske zimske olimpijske reprezentacije primile prijetnju. Olsen je identificirao Kavkazski emirat (Imarat Kavkaz) kao glavnu prijetnju, opisujući ga kao najistaknutiju terorističku skupinu u Rusiji. Rekao je: 'Jasno su iskazali namjeru da provedu napade uoči Igara.' Smatramo da je veća opasnost, s terorističkog stajališta, mogućnost napada izvan samih lokacija Igara, u području oko Sočija ili izvan Sočija u regiji. Predsjednik Barack Obama primio je u utorak izvješće o američkim naporima za jačanje sigurnosti u Sočiju. U priopćenju Bijele kuće stoji: 'Njegov tim uvjerio ga je da poduzimaju sve potrebne mjere u vezi sa sigurnošću Amerikanaca. Uputio ih je da nastave blisko surađivati ​​s ruskom vladom i drugim partnerima kako bi osigurali sigurne i uspješne Igre u Sočiju te da pažljivo razmotre i reagiraju na sve nove informacije koje bi mogle utjecati na sigurnost Igara.'

article_content: According to a University of Washington study released on Friday, California blue whales, the largest animals on Earth once driven to near extinction by whaling, have made a remarkable recovery to near historic, 19th-century levels. The study indicates that the recovery makes California blue whales – now numbering about 2,200, or 97 percent of historical levels – the only known blue whale population to have recovered from whaling. Cole Monnahan, a University of Washington doctoral student and lead author of the study, stated, 'The recovery of California blue whales from whaling demonstrates the ability of blue whale populations to rebuild under careful management and conservation measures.' Despite the comeback, the study's authors note that the whales – which as adults can reach nearly 100 feet in length and weigh 190 tons, twice the weight of the largest known dinosaur – are still being struck by ships off the California coast at numbers exceeding allowable U.S. limits. Conservation groups report that at least 11 blue whales are struck each year along the U.S. West Coast, nearly four times the 'potential biological removal' level of 3.1 permitted under the U.S. Marine Mammal Protection Act. University of Washington assistant professor of aquatic and fishery sciences Tim Branch said, 'Even accepting our results that the current level of ship strikes is not going to cause overall population declines, there is still going to be ongoing concern that we don't want these whales killed by ships.' Even though their numbers have replenished, whales are still being struck by ships off the California coast at numbers above allowable U.S. limits. According to the University of Washington paper and a separate paper published earlier this year, approximately 3,400 blue whales were caught between 1905 and 1971, a number determined in part by examining once-secret Russian whaling archives. The study's authors also mention that the population of California blue whales is now growing more slowly, partly due to ship strikes and because numbers are nearing the habitat limit. California blue whales are currently the only blue whale population known to have recovered from whaling. Monnahan stated, 'Our findings aren't meant to deprive California blue whales of protections that they need going forward.' He added, 'California blue whales are recovering because we took actions to stop catches and start monitoring. If we hadn't, the population might have been pushed to near extinction – an unfortunate fate suffered by other blue whale populations. It's a conservation success story.'
translated_content: Prema studiji Sveučilišta Washington objavljenoj u petak, kalifornijski plavi kitovi, najveće životinje na Zemlji koje su nekoć bile dovedene gotovo do izumiranja zbog kitolova, ostvarili su izvanredan oporavak na razine blizu povijesnih, onih iz 19. stoljeća. Studija pokazuje da oporavak kalifornijskih plavih kitova – kojih sada ima oko 2200, odnosno 97 posto povijesnih razina – čini tu populaciju jedinom poznatom populacijom plavih kitova koja se oporavila od kitolova. Cole Monnahan, doktorand na Sveučilištu Washington i glavni autor studije, izjavio je: 'Oporavak kalifornijskih plavih kitova od kitolova pokazuje sposobnost populacija plavih kitova da se obnove uz pažljivo upravljanje i mjere zaštite.' Unatoč oporavku, autori studije napominju da kitove – koji kao odrasli mogu doseći gotovo 30 metara duljine i težiti 190 tona, dvostruko više od najvećeg poznatog dinosaura – još uvijek udaraju brodovi uz obalu Kalifornije u brojevima koji premašuju dopuštene granice SAD-a. Organizacije za zaštitu prirode izvješćuju da najmanje 11 plavih kitova strada svake godine duž zapadne obale SAD-a, gotovo četiri puta više od razine 'potencijalnog biološkog uklanjanja' od 3,1 koja je dopuštena prema Zakonu o zaštiti morskih sisavaca SAD-a. Pomoćnik profesora znanosti o vodi i ribarstvu na Sveučilištu Washington, Tim Branch, rekao je: 'Čak i ako prihvatimo naše rezultate da trenutna razina udara brodova neće uzrokovati ukupni pad populacije, i dalje postoji zabrinutost da ne želimo da ti kitovi stradavaju od udara brodova.' Iako se njihov broj povećao, kitove još uvijek udaraju brodovi uz obalu Kalifornije u brojevima iznad dopuštenih granica SAD-a. Prema studiji Sveučilišta Washington i zasebnoj studiji objavljenoj ranije ove godine, otprilike 3400 plavih kitova ulovljeno je između 1905. i 1971. godine, a taj je broj utvrđen djelomično ispitivanjem nekoć tajnih ruskih arhiva kitolova. Autori studije također spominju da populacija kalifornijskih plavih kitova sada raste sporije, dijelom zbog udara brodova i zato što se broj kitova približava granicama staništa. Kalifornijski plavi kitovi trenutačno su jedina populacija plavih kitova za koju se zna da se oporavila od kitolova. Monnahan je izjavio: 'Naši nalazi ne znače da kalifornijskim plavim kitovima treba uskratiti zaštitu koja im je potrebna u budućnosti.' Dodao je: 'Kalifornijski plavi kitovi se oporavljaju jer smo poduzeli mjere da zaustavimo izlov i počnemo s praćenjem. Da nismo, populacija bi vjerojatno bila dovedena na rub izumiranja – što je nesretna sudbina koja je zadesila druge populacije plavih kitova. Ovo je priča o uspjehu u zaštiti prirode.'

article_content: The City of Adelaide, the world's most seasoned surviving clipper, predates the Cutty Sark by five years. It once transported emigrants from Scotland to Australia, with around 250,000 people tracing their ancestry back to its passengers. After years of decay in Scotland, preparations are underway to return it to Australia for restoration, nearly 150 years after its construction. In Irvine, North Ayrshire, a massive steel structure has been put together. This will allow the ship to be moved, eventually taking its place as a key feature in a maritime exhibit in Port Adelaide. Constructed in Sunderland in 1864, the City of Adelaide saw service for 23 years before being repurposed as an isolation hospital and later a training vessel known as HMS Carrick. It sank in 1991, and was subsequently raised and moved by the Scottish Maritime Museum. Culture Minister Fiona Hyslop mentioned that the ship's return to Adelaide follows the Scottish government's choice of an Australian group to handle its relocation and restoration. The project coordinator, Jim Tildesley, noted the careful assembly and testing of the transport cradle to ensure it meets required safety standards.

Nakon godina propadanja u Škotskoj, pripreme su u tijeku za njegov povratak u Australiju radi restauracije, gotovo 150 godina nakon izgradnje. U Irvineu, u Sjevernom Ayrshireu, sastavljena je masivna čelična konstrukcija. To će omogućiti premještanje broda, koji će na kraju zauzeti središnje mjesto na pomorskoj izložbi u Port Adelaideu. Izgrađen u Sunderlandu 1864. godine, City of Adelaide je služio 23 godine prije nego što je prenamijenjen u izolacijsku bolnicu, a kasnije i u brod za obuku poznat kao HMS Carrick. Koordinator projekta, Jim Tildesley, istaknuo je pažljivo sastavljanje i testiranje transportnog postolja kako bi se osiguralo da ispunjava potrebne sigurnosne standarde.

article_content: There are certain families -- like the Coppolas and the Gyllenhaals -- where coolness seems infused in their DNA. I'd like to add the Reitmans to that list. Ivan Reitman, the father, produced films like 'Ghostbusters' and 'Animal House,' and his son, Jason, grew up on those sets. 'I was on the set of 'Animal House' when I was 11 days old. It had a profound effect on me,' Jason joked on 'Late Night With Jimmy Fallon.' When he was in his early teens, Jason began working as a production assistant, and his dad even cast him in small roles. 'I was 13 and my dad gave me a scene in 'Kindergarten Cop' kissing a girl -- and that was my first kiss,' Jason said. 'My first kiss was directed by my father. You don't know what it's like to do eight takes of your first kiss while Arnold Schwarzenegger's pointing a gun at you and your dad's like, 'Grab her a little more.'' While Jason probably could have entered filmmaking easily due to his family connections, he turned down directing 'Dude, Where's My Car?' and instead worked on short films to gain experience. 'It's interesting because I avoided working with my dad for a while because I was sensitive to being accused of nepotism,' he said. 'I remember when I was 19, I started a desk calendar company to pay for my first short film so I could say my daddy didn't pay for it. I really established myself through the film festival world, starting at Sundance, and developed a different style of film from my father.' Jason then directed 'Thank You For Smoking,' followed by 'Juno.' Now, he is considered a Best Director/Best Picture contender with his movie 'Up In The Air,' which is receiving critical acclaim. 'Up in the Air' was the first project the two worked on together. 'I love my father and we have a strong bond. I look up to him as a filmmaker and a storyteller,' Jason said. 'It was great, and when I see the credits that say 'produced by Ivan Reitman and Jason Reitman,' my heart swells. It's really cool.' Ivan agreed, 'It's great to be the producer of this kind of movie and share in its success and the goodwill that comes with it,' he said. 'But as a parent, it's a remarkable emotional moment that's hard to describe.' Ivan's career isn't over either -- he is working on a script for 'Ghostbusters 3', and the rumor is that Bill Murray will make a cameo as a ghost. Could this family be any cooler? Ivanova karijera također nije gotova -- radi na scenariju za 'Ghostbusters 3', a glasina kaže da će se Bill Murray pojaviti kao duh. Može li ova obitelj biti još 'cool'? article_content: Following a tour bus accident in Oregon, the number of deaths has increased from five to nine. The bus slid on an icy section of Interstate 84 before plunging down a steep slope near Deadman Pass. Police reports indicate that the bus lost control on the snow and ice-covered lanes of Interstate 84. This caused it to crash through a guardrail in eastern Oregon at approximately 10:30 am, resulting in injuries to over 20 individuals. The bus, which was carrying about 40 passengers on a route from Las Vegas to Vancouver, B.C., fell several hundred feet before stopping, according to state police officials. Emergency personnel responded to the scene, where nine people died, and 26 others sustained injuries in the tour bus crash in Eastern Oregon on Sunday morning. Oregon police stated that the tour bus was en route to Vancouver from Las Vegas when it lost control on the slippery interstate. By Sunday evening, the death toll from the accident had risen from five to nine, with the bus driver among the 26 injured. The tour bus went through a guardrail along an icy Oregon highway before descending several hundred feet down the embankment. Pendleton Fire Chief Gary Woodson stated that all surviving victims had been removed from the bus. Rescue teams used ropes to assist in the retrieval operation. St. Anthony Hospital in Pendleton provided medical care to 26 people involved in the accident, some of whom were later transferred to other medical facilities, according to hospital spokesman Larry Blanc. The bus driver survived but had not yet spoken to police due to the extent of the injuries. Lt. Greg Hastings reported that the crash occurred along the west end of the Blue Mountains, west of Deadman Pass. Highways in eastern Oregon are often icy during winter. The bus came to a stop upright after sliding down the hill, with minimal debris at the site. Survivors were lifted to the roadside with ropes, and at least 26 were taken to a local hospital. Police confirmed the bus lost control on Interstate 84 near Pendleton due to snow and ice, resulting in the crash through a guardrail around 10:30 am. The accident was the second fatal incident on Interstate 84 on Sunday morning, following a rollover accident that killed a 69-year-old man. I-84 is a major east-west highway in Oregon that runs through the Columbia River Gorge. Umatilla County Emergency Manager Jack Remillard identified Mi Joo travel in Vancouver, B.C., as the bus owner. A representative from Mi Joo Travel confirmed bus ownership and its tour of the Western U.S., but declined to provide her name. The U.S. Department of Transportation's bus safety website indicated that Mi Joo Tour & Travel has six buses, with no reported accidents in the last two years. The bus crash was the second fatal accident on I-84 in Oregon on Sunday morning because of icy conditions. Earlier, a 69-year-old man died in a rollover accident.

Autobus se zaustavio uspravno nakon što je skliznuo niz brdo, s minimalnom količinom krhotina na mjestu događaja. Preživjeli su izvučeni na rub ceste užadima, a najmanje 26 ih je prevezeno u lokalnu bolnicu. Policija je potvrdila da je autobus izgubio kontrolu na autocesti Interstate 84 u blizini Pendletona zbog snijega i leda, što je rezultiralo probijanjem zaštitne ograde oko 10:30 sati. Nesreća je bila druga smrtonosna nesreća na autocesti Interstate 84 u nedjelju ujutro, nakon prevrtanja vozila u kojem je poginuo 69-godišnji muškarac. I-84 je glavna autocesta koja se proteže u smjeru istok-zapad u Oregonu i prolazi kroz klisuru rijeke Columbia. Upravitelj hitnih službi okruga Umatilla, Jack Remillard, je identificirao tvrtku Mi Joo Travel iz Vancouvera, B.C., kao vlasnika autobusa. Predstavnica tvrtke Mi Joo Travel je potvrdila vlasništvo nad autobusom i da je autobus bio na putovanju po zapadnom dijelu SAD-a, ali je odbila dati svoje ime. Web stranica američkog Ministarstva prometa (U.S. Department of Transportation) o sigurnosti autobusa je pokazala da Mi Joo Tour & Travel ima šest autobusa i da nije bilo prijavljenih nesreća u posljednje dvije godine. Sudar autobusa je bio druga smrtonosna nesreća na I-84 u Oregonu u nedjelju ujutro zbog zaleđenih uvjeta. Ranije je 69-godišnji muškarac poginuo u nesreći prevrtanja.

article_content: Chocolate enthusiasts are expressing dissatisfaction following Cadbury's announcement to reduce their family-sized chocolate blocks by 'one row' as a cost-saving measure. Unlike Nestle's previous reduction in size for Killer Pythons and Smarties due to the Australian obesity issue, Cadbury is reducing its popular chocolate blocks to save money. The best-selling blocks, previously weighing 220 grams, will be reduced in size by 10 percent. Amanda Banfield, Australasia managing director for Mondelez International, Cadbury's parent company, told the Financial Review that chocolate lovers would likely be disappointed. Anticipating criticism, Ms. Banfield explained that the decision to reduce the family block's size was due to 'unprecedented cost pressures'. Cadbury attributes the change to increased ingredient prices and rising packaging expenses. Cadbury still suggests a retail price of $4.99 per block, but Ms. Banfield clarified that individual stores determine their own pricing. Cadbury's parent company’s pre-tax profit increased by 46 per cent, from $87 million to $127 million, in 2013. In 2013, Tony Abbott pledged that the Liberal Government would support job creation at Cadbury with a $16 million contribution towards factory upgrades. Despite Mr. Abbott's defense of the funding decision in 2014, the promised funds have not yet been provided. Ms. Banfield stated they are awaiting a final decision. Thousands of disgruntled chocolate fans have voiced their complaints on Cadbury’s Facebook page. The announcement on Facebook generated numerous critical comments. Rebecca Isaako commented on the profit margin, while Kyria Economidis accused the company of greed. Kirsty Logan expressed disappointment and suggested switching to Tim Tams. Cadbury chocolate for the Australian market is produced in Claremont, Tasmania. Michele Forrest sarcastically referenced Cadbury's slogan, and Steven Jeffery urged Cadbury to be fair to Australian consumers. The size reduction will affect standard milk chocolate blocks and variations like fruit and nut, rocky road, Crunchie, and Turkish Delight. Cadbury's website states that changes to the 220g family blocks will be noticeable in the coming weeks, while the taste and quality remain the same. The statement explains that confectionery companies globally are facing increasing costs. Cadbury claims it can no longer absorb these costs, leading to the decision to either raise prices or reduce size. The company chose to reduce the block size to maintain affordability for Australian families and support local manufacturing. Cadbury concluded by stating its commitment to new flavors and products while maintaining the taste of its chocolate. Cadbury posted this statement on their Facebook page to explain the changes to chocolate lovers. A photograph shows Tony Abbott during a visit to the Cadbury chocolate factory in Hobart in 2013, during which he promised $16 million in funding.

article_content: For one minute on Wednesday night, the marquee lights of Broadway went dark to honor the memory of Philip Seymour Hoffman. The 46-year-old actor was a respected and vital member of New York's theater community, as evidenced by the outpouring of mourners at a candlelight vigil held by the LAByrinth Theater Company, where Hoffman was a member and an artistic director. He was found dead in his New York apartment on Sunday, apparently from a drug overdose. The Philip Seymour Hoffman we didn't know. 'We come together in a spirit of terrible mourning and incredible loss,' said LAByrinth member and Jesuit priest Father Jim Martin to the crowd gathered in front of the Bank Street Theater. 'But we also come together to celebrate a remarkable life.' Across Hollywood, many of Hoffman's colleagues are offering similar tributes as they cope with his death. Philip Seymour Hoffman: Piecing together his final hours. 'It's a shock, a total shock,' Hoffman's 'Hunger Games' co-star Elizabeth Banks told 'Extra!' on Wednesday. 'He was an incredible actor; everyone respected and loved him. I really enjoyed my time with him. We were playing Candy Crush together just last week. So I'm really, really, really sad.' To Aaron Sorkin, another respected creator whose bond with Hoffman was cemented during their work on 2007's 'Charlie Wilson's War,' Hoffman's death might become someone else's saving grace. In a tribute in Time magazine, Sorkin recalls the 'mini-AA meetings' he and Hoffman would have on the Paramount lot during breaks, where they shared stories as fathers of young children and as recovering drug addicts. 'I told him I felt lucky because I'm squeamish and can't handle needles. He told me to stay squeamish,' Sorkin writes. 'And he said this: If one of us dies of an overdose, probably 10 people who were about to won't.' He meant that our deaths would make news and maybe scare someone clean. In the end, Sorkin believes this will be added to his already astonishing history. '(Hoffman) didn't die because he was partying too hard or because he was depressed—he died because he was an addict on a day of the week with a 'y' in it,' Sorkin said. 'He'll have his well-earned legacy—his Willy Loman that belongs on the same shelf with Lee J. Cobb's and Dustin Hoffman's, his Jamie Tyrone, his Truman Capote, and his Academy Award. Let's add to that 10 people who were about to die who won't now.'
translated_content: U srijedu navečer, na jednu minutu su se ugasila svjetla Broadwaya u čast sjećanja na Philipa Seymoura Hoffmana. Taj 46-godišnji glumac bio je cijenjeni i važan član njujorške kazališne zajednice, što je potvrđeno velikim brojem ožalošćenih na bdjenju uz svijeće koje je organizirala kazališna družina LAByrinth, čiji je Hoffman bio član i umjetnički direktor. Pronađen je mrtav u svom stanu u New Yorku u nedjelju, očito zbog predoziranja drogom. Philip Seymour Hoffman kojeg nismo poznavali. 'Okupili smo se u duhu strašne žalosti i nevjerojatnog gubitka,' rekao je član LAByrintha i isusovački svećenik otac Jim Martin okupljenima ispred kazališta Bank Street. 'Ali okupili smo se i kako bismo proslavili izvanredan život.' Diljem Hollywooda, mnogi Hoffmanovi kolege izražavaju slične počasti dok se nose s njegovom smrću. Philip Seymour Hoffman: Rekonstrukcija njegovih posljednjih sati. 'To je šok, totalni šok,' rekla je Hoffmanova kolegica iz 'Igara gladi', Elizabeth Banks, za 'Extra!' u srijedu. 'Bio je nevjerojatan glumac; svi su ga poštovali i voljeli. Zaista sam uživala u vremenu provedenom s njim. Zajedno smo igrali Candy Crush prošlog tjedna. Jako sam, jako, jako tužna.' Za Aarona Sorkina, još jednog cijenjenog autora čija je veza s Hoffmanom ojačana tijekom rada na filmu 'Charlie Wilson's War' iz 2007., Hoffmanova smrt mogla bi spasiti nečiji život. U posveti u časopisu Time, Sorkin se prisjeća 'mini-AA sastanaka' koje su on i Hoffman imali na Paramountovom setu tijekom pauza, gdje su dijelili priče kao očevi male djece i kao ovisnici koji se oporavljaju. 'Rekao sam mu da se osjećam sretnim jer sam osjetljiv i ne podnosim igle. Rekao mi je da ostanem takav,' piše Sorkin. 'I rekao je ovo: Ako netko od nas umre od predoziranja, vjerojatno deset ljudi koji su bili blizu toga neće.' Mislio je da će naša smrt dospjeti u vijesti i možda preplašiti nekoga da se očisti. Na kraju, Sorkin vjeruje da će se i to pridodati njegovoj već zadivljujućoj ostavštini. '(Hoffman) nije umro zato što se previše zabavljao ili zato što je bio depresivan – umro je zato što je bio ovisnik na dan u tjednu koji ima slovo 'j' u nazivu,' rekao je Sorkin. 'Iza sebe će ostaviti svoju zasluženu ostavštinu – njegovog Willyja Lomana koji stoji na istoj polici s Leejem J. Cobbom i Dustinom Hoffmanom, njegovog Jamieja Tyronea, njegovog Trumana Capotea i njegovog Oscara. Dodajmo tome deset ljudi koji su bili blizu smrti, a sada neće umrijeti.'

article_content: A New York bus monitor, Karen Klein, received over $700,000 in donations from people who saw a YouTube video of her being bullied. A year later, she continues to live modestly. Klein, from Greece, New York, was subjected to profanity, insults, and threats by four middle school students on a school bus. Another student recorded the 10-minute incident on a cellphone, and the video's upload led to $703,833 in donations from around the world. Despite the substantial donation, the 69-year-old still lives in her home of 46 years and hasn't spent the money on luxuries. Klein has retired from her bus monitor job and used $100,000 to start the Karen Klein Anti-Bullying Foundation, promoting kindness through concerts and books. She also assisted family and friends, keeping the remaining funds secure for her retirement. Her daughter, Amanda Klein-Romig, noted that the money hasn't drastically changed her mother's lifestyle. 'It's not like she's jaunting every weekend to a different place,' she told the Huffington Post. Klein's good fortune is largely due to Max Sidorov, a Toronto nutritionist who started a fund for her on Indiegogo after seeing the video. Sidorov, who was also bullied, initially aimed to raise $5,000 for a vacation but received far more. An Indiegogo spokeswoman reported that over 30,000 people from 84 countries contributed. Klein mentioned that the attention has already taken her across North America. She appeared on the Today Show in New York City, a radio show in Boston, visited New Orleans courtesy of Tim McGraw, and traveled to California 'thanks to Anderson Cooper.' The video captures Klein enduring a stream of profanity and threats from the students. One student's disturbing comment included a graphic threat of violence. The four students were suspended for a year and banned from regular bus transportation. Klein considered the punishment appropriate, noting they would attend an alternative school and perform community service for senior citizens. Klein said her decision to retire after three years wasn't solely based on the bullying incident. At the donation ceremony, she emphasized the lasting impact of bullying on children and hoped it would stop. Reflecting on the incident from her home, Klein expressed her hurt at the boys' words.

Glasnogovornica Indiegogo-a izjavila je da je doprinijelo preko 30.000 ljudi iz 84 zemlje. Klein je spomenula da ju je pažnja već odvela diljem Sjeverne Amerike. Gostovala je u emisiji 'Today Show' u New Yorku, u radijskoj emisiji u Bostonu, posjetila New Orleans zahvaljujući Timu McGraw-u i otputovala u Kaliforniju 'zahvaljujući Andersonu Cooperu'. Video prikazuje Klein kako trpi psovke i prijetnje od učenika. Jedan uznemirujući komentar učenika uključivao je eksplicitnu prijetnju nasiljem. Četiri učenika su suspendirana na godinu dana i zabranjen im je redoviti prijevoz autobusom. Klein je smatrala da je kazna primjerena, ističući da će pohađati alternativnu školu i obavljati društveno koristan rad za starije osobe. Klein je rekla da njena odluka o odlasku u mirovinu nakon tri godine nije bila isključivo zbog incidenta zlostavljanja. Na svečanosti doniranja naglasila je trajni utjecaj zlostavljanja na djecu, i nadala se da će to prestati. Razmišljajući o incidentu iz svog doma, Klein je izrazila koliko su je povrijedile riječi dječaka.

article_content: Leicester expects Manu Tuilagi to return from his groin injury later this month, giving him ample time to prepare for the Six Nations. According to the club, the Anglo-Samoan centre is the missing link for England. The 23-year-old’s recovery will be a welcome Christmas present for both Leicester and the national team, who have lamented the absence of his powerful running. Tuilagi has been sidelined since suffering his latest setback in late October during a European Champions Cup match against Ulster. His return in December would be a significant boost for an England squad that has struggled in the midfield. He missed the autumn Tests at Twickenham due to initial concerns that he might not be fit until the new year, potentially jeopardizing his participation in the Six Nations. However, Leicester’s director of rugby, Richard Cockerill, stated that Tuilagi should be back by the end of December, possibly within a week or two, emphasizing the need for rest and treatment. Cockerill acknowledged that the Tigers have missed Tuilagi's forceful presence, saying that his physicality is essential for breaking through opposition lines during stalemates. He added that Tuilagi provides a unique punch to the team. Tuilagi’s absence has also impacted England, forcing national coach Stuart Lancaster to experiment with midfield combinations. Cockerill believes that a fit Tuilagi would solve half of England's midfield problem. Cockerill highlighted Tuilagi's importance to England, noting that the team performs best when Tuilagi is at his best. He hopes Tuilagi will be fit for Christmas and ready for the Six Nations, solving the No. 13 position and leaving the No. 12 position for someone else to figure out. Despite a turbulent start to the season marked by numerous injuries, Leicester's situation is improving. As they prepare to face European champions Toulon on Sunday, England forwards Geoff Parling and Tom Croft are on standby to make their comebacks, likely as replacements. Concerns about repeated concussions had previously clouded Parling’s future, but Cockerill confirmed that the Lions lock has fully recovered. Parling has been gradually reintroduced to training and has a chance to play against Toulon. Croft was set to return from a knee injury the previous weekend but withdrew to attend the birth of his daughter, Victoria. Cockerill anticipates that both Croft and Parling will be eager to regain their places in the Leicester starting XV to secure new contracts. Cockerill stated that Parling has been training fully for the past couple of weeks and is ready to play, having been symptom-free for several weeks following a period of rest recommended by specialists. He detailed Parling’s gradual return to training, including non-contact drills followed by live tackling and scrummaging. He also mentioned that Croft's absence was due to the birth of his daughter, Victoria. Both players are eager to make an impact and secure their future with new contracts.
