article_content: By Steve Robson Published: 07:57 EST, May 22, 2013 Updated: 14:26 EST, May 22, 2013 Remarkable: A 33-year-old Polish man, whose face was torn off by stone-cutting machinery, gives a thumbs-up after a successful face transplant. Doctors in Poland report they have performed a total face transplant on a 33-year-old man whose face was torn off in an accident involving stone-cutting machinery. Surgeons at the Oncology Center in Gliwice stated the 27-hour operation was performed on May 15, just weeks after the accident. The head of the medical team, Adam Maciejewski, said it was the world's first life-saving face transplant performed so soon after such extensive damage. The accident occurred on April 23. Previous transplants required months or years of preparation. A computer-generated image, provided by the hospital, illustrates the extensive damage the man suffered from the industrial accident. Surgery was required to reconstruct his face, jaws, palate, and the bottom of his eye sockets. Incredibly, the emergency procedure appears to be a success. A photo of the patient taken yesterday, six days after the surgery, showed him giving a thumbs-up from his hospital bed. A Spanish farmer underwent the world's first full-face transplant in March 2010. Oscar, whose surname was withheld to protect his privacy, had lost most of his face in a hunting accident involving a gun. He was left unable to breathe, swallow, or speak properly. WARNING: GRAPHIC CONTENT Please scroll down for video Life-saving: Doctors performed the surgery on May 15 in a 27-hour operation. Medical history: Adam Maciejewski, the head of the team of doctors, said it was the world's first life-saving face transplant carried out so soon after the damage. Devastating injuries: This computer-generated image shows the extensive damage suffered by the 33-year-old victim alongside a normal, healthy skull. Breakthrough: Doctors at the Oncology Center in Gliwice said the 27-hour operation was performed May 15, just weeks after the accident. Nine earlier surgical attempts to rebuild his face had failed. He made medical history when he became the first person in the world to undergo a full facial transplant. The 24-hour operation involved 30 surgeons, anaesthetists, nurses, and other medical experts at the Vall d’Hebron hospital in Barcelona. The complicated procedure included plastic surgery and microsurgery to repair blood vessels. Oscar required speech therapy, physiotherapy, and facial therapy to help him recover full movement in his facial muscles. Enlarge There have been 11 partial face transplants carried out since Isabelle Dinoire had her face repaired by French surgeons in 2005. Five were performed in France, two in Spain, two in the U.S., one in Egypt, and one in China. There have also been two full face transplants: Oscar and a man known as Jerome in France. None have been performed in the UK. Oscar (centre) with his sister and Dr. Joan Barrett at a press conference. He can now eat a soft food diet and is learning to speak again.

article_content: On Saturday, November 4th, Elon Musk's AI company, xAI, is set to introduce its initial AI model, as announced by the Tesla CEO on Friday. This unveiling occurs nearly a year after ChatGPT from OpenAI became a global sensation, significantly boosting the acceptance of generative AI. According to Musk's Friday statement, the upcoming xAI model is purportedly 'the best that currently exists' in certain crucial aspects. Musk, who has often criticized the AI initiatives and perceived censorship within major tech firms, previously declared his intention to create an AI focused on 'maximum truth-seeking' to explore the universe's fundamental nature, aiming to compete with Google's Bard and Microsoft's Bing AI. Founded in July 2022, xAI's team comprises experts from renowned AI research groups, including Google's DeepMind and Microsoft. While Musk's social media platform X (previously known as Twitter) operates independently from xAI, the two collaborate closely. XAI also partners with Tesla and other ventures led by Musk. Oracle's co-founder, Larry Ellison, mentioned in September that xAI had secured a contract to train its AI using Oracle's cloud infrastructure. This underscores xAI's extensive computational demands, considering Oracle's robust cloud capabilities. Musk suggested that xAI's capabilities surpass those of existing models like GPT-3 and Google's LaMDA. With substantial resources and top-tier AI talent, xAI potentially has the ability to outpace current industry leaders. However, some analysts remain doubtful regarding Musk's ambitious assertions about the startup's emerging technology. The Saturday launch will likely serve as an early-stage test with limited availability. Wider distribution will likely be contingent, at least partly, on thorough safety assessments to mitigate potential risks associated with the AI model. Musk envisions xAI eventually aligning philosophically with human values, although this longer-term objective may take considerable time to achieve. article_content: A Virginia court has decided that Janet Jenkins, who helped raise a girl with her former female partner in Vermont, can visit the child in Virginia. This decision stands even though Virginia doesn't acknowledge same-sex unions. The Virginia Supreme Court determined that the civil union between Janet Jenkins and Lisa Miller in 2000 granted Vermont, and its laws concerning same-sex unions, authority over later disagreements about custody and visitation rights. In 2003, Miller relocated to Virginia with the child. Subsequently, a Vermont court awarded visitation rights to Jenkins. However, Miller challenged this in a Virginia court, which initially ruled against Jenkins' visitation rights. Legal experts considered this case a pioneering conflict between state courts regarding significant legal questions arising from same-sex unions. Joseph Price, Jenkins' attorney from Arent Fox, stated that the ruling reinforces the established legal principle that custody and visitation disputes should remain in the state where they began. Price emphasized that one cannot simply move such disputes to another state, and Virginia was essentially obligated to uphold the judgments and orders from Vermont. Vermont is among a few states that permit same-sex partners to enter civil unions. Two years after Vermont recognized Miller and Jenkins' relationship, Miller gave birth to Isabella through artificial insemination. As the relationship soured, Miller moved to Virginia with Isabella. A Vermont court later dissolved the civil union, granting Miller custody of Isabella but awarding visitation rights to Jenkins. Following this, Miller sought the Virginia courts' jurisdiction to overturn the decision, as Virginia does not recognize same-sex unions or marriages. Eventually, a Virginia judge determined that Jenkins had no parental or visitation rights. The Virginia high court's decision now returns the case to Vermont's jurisdiction, allowing Jenkins to visit her daughter, who is currently six years old. Mathew Staver, Miller's attorney, expressed his disappointment that the court avoided addressing broader legal questions. Staver, who chairs Liberty Counsel, a law firm advocating for 'traditional families,' remarked that this case highlights the interconnectedness of states in same-sex marriage debates and emphasizes the need for state laws protecting traditional marriages. In 2005, Miller stated that her actions were in Isabella's best interest and declared that she was no longer a lesbian. She emphasized her role as Isabella's mother, conceiving and birthing her, and argued that Isabella should remain solely in her care as she is the only parental figure Isabella recognizes. Miller resides with Isabella in Winchester, Virginia. Jenkins, who did not immediately comment on the ruling, stated in 2005 that she was fighting for her parental rights and believes justice will prevail for Isabella, pledging to remain involved in her life as long as possible. She affirmed her status as Isabella's mother, emphasizing Isabella's birth and life in Vermont. Price noted that Jenkins, who resides in Fair Haven, Vermont, was scheduled to visit Isabella the previous weekend, but Miller did not bring the child. This ruling follows the California Supreme Court's recent decision to legalize same-sex marriage. Massachusetts also allows same-sex marriage, while Vermont and three other states permit civil unions, and 12 other states grant some legal rights to gay and lesbian couples. Virginia amended its constitution in 2007 to define marriage as between one man and one woman.

Vrhovni sud Virginije utvrdio je da je civilna zajednica između Janet Jenkins i Lise Miller 2000. godine dala Vermontu, i njegovim zakonima o istospolnim zajednicama, ovlast nad kasnijim nesuglasicama oko skrbništva i prava na posjete. Sud u Vermontu kasnije je razveo civilnu zajednicu, dodijelivši Miller skrbništvo nad Isabellom, ali dodijelivši pravo na posjete Jenkins. Mathew Staver, odvjetnik Miller, izrazio je razočaranje što je sud izbjegao rješavanje širih pravnih pitanja. Staver, koji je predsjednik Liberty Counsela, odvjetničkog društva koje zagovara 'tradicionalne obitelji', primijetio je da ovaj slučaj naglašava međusobnu povezanost država u raspravama o istospolnim brakovima i naglašava potrebu za državnim zakonima koji štite tradicionalne brakove. Godine 2005. Miller je izjavila da su njezini postupci u najboljem interesu Isabelle i izjavila da više nije lezbijka. Naglasila je svoju ulogu Isabelle kao majke, začevši je i rodviši, i tvrdila je da bi Isabella trebala ostati isključivo u njezinoj skrbi jer je ona jedina roditeljska figura koju Isabella prepoznaje. Miller živi s Isabellom u Winchesteru, Virginia. Jenkins, koja nije odmah komentirala presudu, izjavila je 2005. godine da se bori za svoja roditeljska prava i vjeruje da će pravda prevladati za Isabellu, obećavajući da će ostati uključena u njezin život što je dulje moguće. Potvrdila je svoj status Isabelle kao majke, naglašavajući Isabelleino rođenje i život u Vermontu. Price je primijetio da je Jenkins, koja živi u Fair Havenu, Vermont, trebala posjetiti Isabellu prethodnog vikenda, ali Miller nije dovela dijete. Ova presuda slijedi nedavnu odluku Vrhovnog suda Kalifornije o legalizaciji istospolnih brakova. Massachusetts također dopušta istospolne brakove, dok Vermont i tri druge države dopuštaju civilne zajednice, a 12 drugih država daje neka zakonska prava istospolnim parovima. Virginia je 2007. godine izmijenila svoj ustav kako bi definirala brak kao zajednicu između jednog muškarca i jedne žene.

article_content: Despite two recent defeats to Australia and five losses against Sri Lanka before Christmas, England's one-day team may be shaping up to surpass expectations at the World Cup. While it would require considerable optimism to view England as serious contenders, there are signs – contrary to previous form and a history of 50-over setbacks – that things might improve. England appears to have finalized their optimal lineup just in time, reminiscent of their preparation before winning the World Twenty20 in 2010, potentially defying predictions of another disappointing World Cup. Eoin Morgan has impressed since becoming the one-day captain. Coach Peter Moores believes England's Tri-series performance demonstrates their ability to compete at the World Cup. The eleven players who overcame a psychological challenge to defeat Australia in Hobart will likely form the team for the World Cup opener against a formidable host nation in Melbourne. Continued improvement, marked by significant contributions from Ian Bell, Steven Finn, Moeen Ali, Jimmy Anderson, and Eoin Morgan, could propel them beyond the quarter-finals. England coach Peter Moores expressed confidence before their match against India at the WACA and a potential Tri-series final against Australia. ‘The aim was to quickly establish our team for the World Cup, and we're progressing well,’ Moores stated. ‘We have a versatile squad with strong competition for places.’ ‘We're determined to reach the Tri-series final and believe we can compete strongly if we perform to our potential. Australia is a strong team, but we are too, and we’re showing it. We feel we’re moving in the right direction.’ Steven Finn, after a challenging two years, has shown excellent form in Australia. ‘The Hobart game showed an England side scoring 300 and feeling they should have scored more. Our bowling will also improve, with Stuart Broad and Jimmy Anderson returning from injury.’ England's key decisions ahead of this tour have been validated, despite winning only one in three Tri-series games. The dismissal of Alastair Cook, though late in their World Cup strategy, has seen Morgan emerge as a capable leader who has handled an attempted blackmail regarding his private life effectively. Cook's departure allowed Ian Bell to excel, justifying his selection over Alex Hales with a spectacular innings of 141 at the Bellerive Oval. Importantly, Finn is regaining the form that made him a formidable one-day bowler in New Zealand two years ago, recovering from a severe action collapse during last year’s Ashes tour. ‘The dressing room was delighted with Finny’s performance at the Gabba,’ Moores said, referring to Finn’s five-wicket haul against India. ‘He's worked hard to recover. I was equally pleased with his follow-up performance. Ian Bell has excelled since replacing Alex Hales at the top of the order. ‘He bowled well under pressure, generating reverse swing and taking wickets. He showed his old bounce. It’s fantastic. He’s a proven performer with a great record, and he deserves credit for his hard work.’ ‘It would be a huge boost if he returns to his peak form. Steven has overcome a lot and now wants to enjoy his cricket. He’s in a good place.’ After losing one-day series to Sri Lanka and India last summer and suffering a heavy defeat in Sri Lanka, England seemed far from a team capable of playing modern, dynamic one-day cricket. Now, three weeks before the World Cup, optimism is cautiously returning. ‘I said on taking over that our aim was to select the best 15 players for the World Cup,’ Moores stated. ‘Alastair didn’t make the cut, which was difficult, but it felt like the right decision. We still have time to compete with the best at this World Cup. Scoring over 300 in three of five games shows we’re playing well. ‘Our team is developing, and things are coming together. We want to keep things simple, settle the team, and enjoy playing. We’re representing our country, we have the best 15 players, and we need to work hard to win games.’ Moores felt it was the 'right time' to drop former captain Alastair Cook.

Trener Peter Moores vjeruje da izvedba Engleske u Tri-seriji pokazuje da se mogu natjecati na Svjetskom prvenstvu. Jedanaest igrača koji su prevladali psihološki izazov kako bi pobijedili Australiju u Hobartu vjerojatno će činiti momčad za otvaranje Svjetskog prvenstva protiv snažne reprezentacije domaćina u Melbourneu. Također vjerujem da će se i naša igra kuglanjem poboljšati, s obzirom na to da se Stuart Broad i Jimmy Anderson vraćaju nakon ozljeda.’ Ključne odluke engleskog tima uoči ove turneje su se pokazale ispravnima, iako su pobijedili samo u jednoj od tri utakmice Tri-serije. Odlazak Alastaira Cooka, iako se dogodio kasno u strategiji za Svjetsko prvenstvo, omogućio je Morganu da se istakne kao sposoban vođa koji se uspješno nosio s pokušajem ucjene vezane uz njegov privatni život. Cookov odlazak je omogućio Ianu Bellu da se istakne, opravdavajući izbor umjesto Alexa Halesa spektakularnom izvedbom i postignutih 141 trčanja na Bellerive Ovalu. Važno je da Finn vraća formu koja ga je prije dvije godine učinila teškim protivnikom u Novom Zelandu, oporavljajući se od pada forme tijekom prošlogodišnje serije Ashes. ‘Svi u svlačionici su bili oduševljeni Finnyjevom izvedbom na Gabbi,’ rekao je Moores, referirajući se na Finnyjevih pet osvojenih wicketa protiv Indije. ‘Puno je radio na oporavku. Jednako sam zadovoljan i njegovom sljedećom izvedbom. Ian Bell se pokazao odličnim otkako je zamijenio Alexa Halesa na vrhu poretka. ‘Dobro je bacao pod pritiskom, stvarajući obrnuti zamah i uzimajući wicke. Pokazao je stari sjaj. To je fantastično. On je dokazani igrač s odličnim rezultatima i zaslužuje pohvale za svoj trud.’ ‘Veliko bi nam ohrabrenje bilo kad bi se vratio u svoju najbolju formu. Steven je puno toga prošao i sada želi uživati u kriketu. U dobrom je stanju.’ Nakon što su prošlog ljeta izgubili serije jednodnevnih utakmica od Šri Lanke i Indije, te doživjeli težak poraz u Šri Lanki, činilo se da je Engleska daleko od momčadi koja je sposobna igrati moderan i dinamičan kriket. Sada, tri tjedna prije Svjetskog prvenstva, oprezni optimizam se vraća. ‘Kada sam preuzeo momčad, rekao sam da je naš cilj odabrati 15 najboljih igrača za Svjetsko prvenstvo,’ izjavio je Moores. ‘Alastair nije ušao u momčad, što je bila teška odluka, ali se činila ispravnom. Još uvijek imamo vremena da se natječemo s najboljima na ovom Svjetskom prvenstvu. Činjenica da smo postigli više od 300 bodova u tri od pet utakmica pokazuje da igramo dobro. ‘Naša momčad napreduje i stvari se slažu. Želimo zadržati jednostavnost, stabilizirati momčad i uživati u igri. Predstavljamo svoju zemlju, imamo 15 najboljih igrača i moramo naporno raditi da bismo pobjeđivali.’ Moores je smatrao da je 'pravo vrijeme' za izbacivanje bivšeg kapetana Alastaira Cooka.

article_content: A few hundred people marched in Brooklyn on Sunday to protest the fatal beating of Jose Sucuzhanay, a 31-year-old Ecuadorean man. Authorities are investigating the December 7 incident as a possible hate crime. Sucuzhanay was attacked after leaving a party at a church. Demonstrators carried signs reading 'No more hate crimes' and marched a half-mile in the neighborhood where police report he was struck in the head with a bottle and beaten with an aluminum baseball bat. Sucuzhanay died from his injuries on Friday at Elmhurst Hospital, just hours before his mother arrived from Ecuador, according to his family. Police stated that Sucuzhanay's attackers used racial slurs. No arrests have been made, but police are offering a $22,000 reward for information. Diego Sucuzhanay, one of Jose's brothers, believes the attack was a hate crime, noting that nothing was stolen from his brother. Diego did not participate in the march, instead assisting his mother with arrangements to return Jose's body to Ecuador. Police said that Jose and his brother Romel were approached by several men in a car in Brooklyn's Bushwick section, near their home, after leaving the church party. The men shouted anti-gay and anti-Latino slurs before attacking the brothers. Romel, 34, sustained minor scrapes and has spoken with detectives. Police have released a sketch of a possible suspect. New York Mayor Michael Bloomberg called the attack 'a pointless and gutless crime' and promised a thorough investigation and prosecution of those responsible, in a statement. Family spokesman Francisco Moya said that Jose Sucuzhanay had been a legal resident of the United States for over a decade. Diego Sucuzhanay mentioned that Jose had established a successful real estate business in a low-income area to help the community. He hired a diverse team, including African-Americans and Latinos, and was raising two children: a 9-year-old son and a 4-year-old daughter. 'We were proud of him,' Diego Sucuzhanay said. Diego recounted that the family wished Jose's mother could have reached his bedside before he died. Doctors had informed them that Jose was brain dead since the attack and that machines were keeping him alive until his heart failed on Friday. At a press conference outside the hospital on Sunday, Diego Sucuzhanay said, 'My heart is broken, but my brother's [memory] will live on.' When asked how his brother would be remembered, he paused and answered, 'For being the victim of a hate crime.' Although he didn't participate in the demonstration, Diego expressed gratitude to those who did and emphasized the need for tolerance. 'We definitely have to speak out,' he said.

Na konferenciji za novinare ispred bolnice u nedjelju, Diego Sucuzhanay je izjavio: 'Moje srce je slomljeno, ali uspomena na mog brata živjet će vječno.' article_content: A 9-year-old girl who was unintentionally caught in the crossfire and grazed by a bullet after a young gunman opened fire at her apartment building has been discharged from the hospital. Amanda Chauan was an innocent bystander when 17-year-old Billy James Jr. allegedly fired six shots from his bicycle at her Bronx, New York apartment complex on Friday night before fleeing the scene. One of the bullets grazed Amanda in the stomach. Although she has recovered and been released from the hospital, her family reports that she is afraid to return home. Amanda's mother, Magaly Cintron, told the New York Daily News that Amanda 'doesn't want to go back,' and 'doesn't want to be there.' Amanda smiled to reporters as she left the hospital, carrying a doll and a purse. While physically recovered, she remains distressed, and her mother is determined to relocate the family to a safer neighborhood. A $22,000 reward is being offered for information leading to the capture of Billy James Jr., who remains at large. Witnesses reported that James was riding his bicycle through the Bronx, New York, around 9:45 p.m. when he discharged a firearm. One of the bullets struck Amanda, who was playing in front of her apartment complex on Bailey Avenue and 234th Street with her 5-year-old brother, Gustavo, while their mother was upstairs. Her traumatized brother watched as her mother’s boyfriend, who witnessed the shooting, rescued Amanda and rushed her to North Central Bronx Hospital. She was later transferred to Jacobi Medical Center. Amanda's grandmother, Wanda Forte, stated, 'He was right there next to her. I don’t know how he didn’t get hit, too. They’re just little kids. This shouldn’t happen,' as reported by the Daily News. Amanda’s father, also named Gustavo, expressed his gratitude that his daughter is alive. Amanda, the middle child of three, is reportedly a big basketball fan. Police indicated that the intended target of the shooter was unclear, with witnesses claiming the shots were fired randomly. Neighbor Joanny Jiminez, 19, who was inside the Bailey Avenue lobby during the shooting, described the scene as 'chaos,' recounting that 'Everyone was running around...The little girl, she was walking around panicking. She was screaming, ‘I can’t deal with this right now!'' article_content: I never thought I'd be the person on the internet lamenting the decline of combustion engines. My reporting usually focuses on the increasing number of impressive electric vehicles coming to market. As someone concerned about the planet's future, I recognize that EVs are essential for mitigating the environmental crisis. So, what led me to rave about the Aston Martin DBX707, an SUV that achieves a mere 17 miles per gallon? The answer is simple: I drove it, and it was genuinely enjoyable. EVs offer near-silent operation and remarkable acceleration, a combination that's initially appealing but can become monotonous. Depress the accelerator in almost any new electric car, SUV, or even a truck, and you'll experience instant, effortless acceleration. Indeed, in this new electric era, a Kia model reaches 60 mph in just 3.4 seconds. This is simply the advantage of electric motors, making high speed accessible to a wider range of vehicles. After driving the DBX707 for a week, I was reminded that, regardless of how impressively fast EVs become, a crucial element is missing from their driving experience: sound. From the driver's seat, it's often difficult to even tell if an EV is running. There's no such ambiguity with the DBX707. Upon ignition, its 697-horsepower, turbocharged V8 engine emits a distinctive, powerful growl, signaling your presence to everyone nearby. Each time I accelerated, such as when entering a highway, a subtle rumble would escalate into a resonant, cabin-filling roar as the SUV gained momentum and shifted gears. The sound and vibrations, created by thousands of precisely timed explosions, added a dramatic dimension absent in battery-powered vehicles. With an EV, there's no anticipation; just immediate acceleration. Conversely, in a high-performance gasoline car like the DBX707, the buildup contributes to the excitement. As a refined version of Aston Martin's DBX SUV, the DBX707 possessed other desirable qualities. The $276,000 SUV (as tested) justified its hefty price with a sophisticated leather interior, attention-grabbing design, adaptable suspension, and sports car-like handling. My primary complaint was the Aston's outdated infotainment system, which lacked a touchscreen, an unacceptable omission for a vehicle costing a quarter of a million dollars. Car manufacturers are addressing the sound issue; EVs commonly incorporate artificial acceleration noises into the cabin to simulate the ambiance of conventional cars. Sometimes, the resulting sound resembles a gasoline engine, while other times it's more like a futuristic drone. I often find these synthetic noises irritating and try to disable them. Some carmakers are going further. The all-electric Hyundai Ioniq 5N will project simulated engine sounds both inside and outside the vehicle, also mimicking gear shifts. Dodge, known for its powerful muscle cars, introduced an electric prototype with a simulated exhaust that rivals a jet engine in volume. The Pininfarina Battista, a 1,900-horsepower electric supercar, growls at onlookers and vibrates to replicate the sensation of a gas engine under the hood. Determining the appropriate sound profile for future EVs will likely be most critical for brands like Lamborghini, whose customers expect loud, powerful engines. However, for marques like Rolls-Royce (which recently launched its first EV), silence is a key selling point. Likewise, for many average car buyers, quietness is a luxury. But will artificial 'vroom vroom' noises win over hardcore car enthusiasts? I doubt it. Ed Kim, chief analyst at AutoPacific, shares this view, stating that they are likely a passing trend. 'I don't know that 10 years from now we'll still be seeing this,' he said. 'Ultimately, I think many drivers desire an experience that's authentic and genuine.'
translated_content: Nikada nisam mislio/mislila da ću biti ta osoba na internetu koja žali za propadanjem motora s unutarnjim izgaranjem. Moje izvještavanje obično se fokusira na sve veći broj impresivnih električnih vozila koja dolaze na tržište. Kao netko koga brine budućnost planeta, prepoznajem da su električna vozila ključna za ublažavanje ekološke krize. Dakle, što me navelo da hvalim Aston Martin DBX707, SUV koji postiže samo 17 milja po galonu? Odgovor je jednostavan: vozio/vozila sam ga, i bilo je zaista ugodno. Električna vozila nude gotovo bešuman rad i izvanredno ubrzanje, kombinacija koja je u početku privlačna, ali može postati monotona. Pritisnite papučicu gasa u gotovo svakom novom električnom automobilu, SUV-u ili čak kamionu, i doživjet ćete trenutno ubrzanje bez napora. Doista, u ovoj novoj električnoj eri, jedan model Kie dostiže 60 mph za samo 3,4 sekunde. To je jednostavno prednost električnih motora, što čini velike brzine dostupnima širem rasponu vozila. Nakon što sam tjedan dana vozio/vozila DBX707, podsjetilo me to da, bez obzira na to koliko impresivno brzi postanu električni automobili, ključni element nedostaje u njihovom iskustvu vožnje: zvuk. S vozačkog sjedala često je teško uopće reći radi li električni automobil. Nema takve nejasnoće kod DBX707. Prilikom paljenja, njegov 697 KS snažan, turbo V8 motor ispušta prepoznatljiv, snažan zvuk, signalizirajući vašu prisutnost svima u blizini. Svaki put kad bih ubrzao/ubrzala, na primjer, prilikom uključivanja na autocestu, suptilno tutnjanje bi eskaliralo u rezonantan zvuk koji ispunjava kabinu, dok je SUV dobivao na zamahu i mijenjao brzine. Zvuk i vibracije, stvoreni tisućama precizno tempiranih eksplozija, dodali su dramatičnu dimenziju koja nedostaje vozilima na baterije. Kod električnog vozila nema iščekivanja; samo trenutno ubrzanje. Nasuprot tome, kod benzinskog automobila visokih performansi, poput DBX707, taj 'build-up' doprinosi uzbuđenju. Kao profinjena verzija Aston Martinovog DBX SUV-a, DBX707 posjeduje i druge poželjne kvalitete. SUV, čija je cijena testnog modela iznosila 276.000 dolara, opravdao je svoju visoku cijenu sofisticiranom kožnom unutrašnjošću, dizajnom koji privlači pozornost, prilagodljivim ovjesom i upravljanjem poput sportskog automobila. Moja glavna zamjerka bio je Astonov zastarjeli informacijsko-zabavni sustav, kojem je nedostajao zaslon osjetljiv na dodir, što je neprihvatljiv propust za vozilo koje košta četvrt milijuna dolara. Proizvođači automobila rješavaju problem zvuka; električna vozila obično ugrađuju umjetne zvukove ubrzanja u kabinu kako bi simulirali ambijent konvencionalnih automobila. Ponekad rezultirajući zvuk podsjeća na benzinski motor, dok je ponekad više poput futurističkog zujanja. Često smatram ove sintetičke zvukove iritantnima i pokušavam ih isključiti. Neki proizvođači automobila idu i dalje. Potpuno električni Hyundai Ioniq 5N projicirat će simulirane zvukove motora i unutar i izvan vozila, također oponašajući promjenu stupnjeva prijenosa. Dodge, poznat po svojim snažnim 'muscle' automobilima, predstavio je električni prototip s simuliranim ispuhom koji konkurira mlaznom motoru po glasnoći. Pininfarina Battista, električni superautomobil od 1900 konjskih snaga, reži na prolaznike i vibrira kako bi replicirao osjećaj benzinskog motora ispod haube. Određivanje odgovarajućeg zvučnog profila za buduće električne automobile vjerojatno će biti najkritičnije za marke poput Lamborghinija, čiji kupci očekuju glasne, snažne motore. Međutim, za marke poput Rolls-Roycea (koji je nedavno lansirao svoj prvi električni automobil), tišina je ključna prodajna točka. Isto tako, za mnoge prosječne kupce automobila, tišina je luksuz. No, hoće li umjetni zvukovi 'vroom vroom' osvojiti 'hardcore' ljubitelje automobila? Sumnjam. Ed Kim, glavni analitičar u AutoPacificu, dijeli ovo mišljenje, navodeći da je to vjerojatno prolazni trend. 'Ne znam hoćemo li to još uvijek viđati za 10 godina', rekao je. 'U konačnici, mislim da mnogi vozači žele iskustvo koje je autentično i istinsko.'

article_content: At least one person died when a National Guard helicopter crashed in the waters off San Juan, Puerto Rico, a Federal Aviation Administration spokeswoman said Tuesday, citing preliminary information. 'The preliminary information we have is that the wreckage of the Army National Guard aircraft was found in the water near San Juan,' spokeswoman Diane Spitaliere said in an e-mail. The aircraft was destroyed, she added. The crash occurred late Monday, according to Lt. Cmdr. Matthew Moorlag of the U.S. Coast Guard in Miami, Florida. The Coast Guard received a call late Monday night requesting search and rescue assistance, said Ricardo Castrodad, spokesman for the Coast Guard in San Juan. He stated that three crew members and three passengers – one guardsman and two civilians from Puerto Rico – were on board. The UH-72 Lakota helicopter had departed from San Juan on Monday night, and it crashed one nautical mile northeast of the Puerto Rican coast. Castrodad did not provide information on casualties but confirmed that the search for survivors was ongoing. CNN’s Mike Ahlers and Maria P. White contributed to this report.

article_content: Jordan Linn Graham, 22, is awaiting trial under house arrest after being accused of pushing her husband off a cliff in Glacier National Park. Initially, Graham stated that her husband, Cody Lee Johnson, had gone hiking with friends. Prosecutors in Montana highlighted an email purportedly from a man named 'Tony' which surfaced while Johnson was still missing. This email claimed Johnson had died from a hiking accident. The email, suggesting the search should be stopped, was sent three days after Johnson's disappearance. However, it was traced back to the computer of Graham's stepfather, Steven Rutledge. FBI Special Agent Steven Liss indicated that the email account was created the same day the message was sent. Later, Graham allegedly confessed to police that an argument led her to push Johnson, resulting in his fatal fall. She appeared in Missoula court and was placed under house arrest until her trial. Johnson, 25, passed away on July 7. Graham allegedly admitted to the pushing on July 16 but wasn't arrested for second-degree murder until the following Monday. According to documents, around the time Johnson's body was discovered, Graham had been having doubts about their marriage. She reportedly told an FBI agent that she and Johnson were arguing on July 7 in the Loop Trail area. An affidavit states that Graham pushed Johnson with both hands in the back, causing him to fall face-first off the cliff. Johnson was reported missing on July 8 after not appearing at work. Later, Graham claimed to have found his body. Graham had initially told investigators that Johnson had left with friends in a dark car with Washington license plates on the night of July 7. A family friend, Tracey Maness, mentioned that Johnson was excited about his wedding and loved Graham. Graham had texted a friend about her reservations regarding the marriage shortly before Johnson's death, saying, 'Oh well, I'm going to talk to him.' She also texted, 'But dead serious if u don't hear from me at all again tonight, something happened.' Social media posts showed the couple got engaged in December 2012. After Johnson's death, Graham posted photos and messages expressing her grief and love for him.

article_content: New England Patriots star Vince Wilfork has proved to be a hero not just on the gridiron, but on the highway as well. The defensive tackle spotted a crash in Foxborough, Massachusetts, on his way home from winning the AFC Championship on Sunday night and stopped to help a driver whose Jeep had flipped over on the highway. According to police, the woman was trapped inside, and the 6-foot-2, 325lb Wilfork climbed on top of her overturned SUV and pulled her out with one hand. Vince Wilfork was driving home from the Patriots game when he discovered Mary Ellen Brooks trapped in her Jeep after she crashed and flipped it. When asked about his rescue, Wilfork, a 33-year-old NFL veteran, downplayed his actions. 'I just wanted to help. I think anybody would’ve done the same,' he told the Boston Globe on Monday. 'Through football and the course of life, I’ve learned to stay poised in certain situations. I’m pretty sure she was scared, so the last thing I wanted to do was have her panic. The first thing I told her is "Don’t panic, I’ll get you out of here," and I got her out.' Once police arrived and took control of the crash scene, he left and continued on his journey home. Police say the woman, 38-year-old Mary Ellen Brooks, was driving drunk when she crashed and flipped her vehicle. She was arrested for operating under the influence and negligent operation of a motor vehicle. She was not seriously injured in the crash. Vince Wilfork is a 6-foot-2, 325lb defensive tackle who helped lead the Patriots to the Super Bowl after their win over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night.

Prema policiji, žena je bila zarobljena unutra, a Wilfork, visok 1,88 m i težak 147 kg, popeo se na njezin prevrnuti SUV i izvukao je jednom rukom. Upitan o svom spašavanju, Wilfork, 33-godišnji NFL veteran, umanjio je svoje postupke. 'Samo sam htio pomoći. Mislim da bi svatko učinio isto,' rekao je za Boston Globe u ponedjeljak. 'Kroz nogomet i život naučio sam ostati smiren u određenim situacijama. Prilično sam siguran da se uplašila, pa sam najmanje želio da paničari. Prvo što sam joj rekao je: "Ne paničari, izvući ću te odavde", i izvukao sam je.' Nakon što je policija stigla i preuzela kontrolu nad mjestom nesreće, otišao je i nastavio svojim putem kući. Policija kaže da je žena, 38-godišnja Mary Ellen Brooks, vozila pod utjecajem alkohola kad je srušila i prevrnula svoje vozilo. Uhićena je zbog vožnje pod utjecajem alkohola i nesavjesnog upravljanja motornim vozilom. U nesreći nije bila ozbiljno ozlijeđena. Vince Wilfork je defenzivni igrač visok 1,88 m i težak 147 kg koji je pomogao Patriotima da se plasiraju u Super Bowl nakon pobjede nad Indianapolis Coltsima u nedjelju navečer.

article_content: Reports indicate that NSA whistleblower Edward Snowden has requested temporary asylum in Russia after spending three weeks at a Moscow airport to avoid espionage prosecution in the United States. Snowden is seeking refuge in Latin America following leaks about U.S. government surveillance programs but has avoided flights that could be intercepted by the U.S. since arriving in Russia from Hong Kong on June 23. Russia's RIA Novosti news agency quoted lawyer Anatoly Kucherena, stating Snowden submitted the asylum request to Russia's Federal Migration Service. The service has not yet commented. Snowden's lawyer stated that he requested temporary asylum after a meeting at Moscow's Sheremetyevo airport with human rights activists. 'He reached the conclusion that he needs to write an application for temporary asylum (in Russia), and this procedure has just been done,' said Kucherena. 'For now he is not going to go anywhere. For now he plans to stay in Russia.' Kucherena added that if temporary asylum is granted, Snowden should have the same rights as other citizens and be free to work and travel in Russia. The asylum application could resolve his uncertain situation but might worsen tensions between the United States and Russia, which has declined to extradite him. The head of Russia's Federal Migration Service (FMS) confirmed receipt of Snowden's application. Wikileaks said Snowden applied for 'a temporary protection visa'. Snowden, 30, is in the transit zone of Moscow's Sheremetyevo airport, considered neutral territory. Officials stated the decision would be made by Russia's Federal Migration Service, but President Vladimir Putin is expected to make the final decision. Putin has invited President Barack Obama to a Moscow summit in September and wants to avoid Snowden harming relations with Washington. Snowden stated he would seek refuge in Russia only until he can travel to Bolivia, Venezuela, or Nicaragua, all offering political asylum. He said the United States and allies prevent him from reaching those countries. Washington revoked Snowden's passport and urged other nations against assisting him. Kucherena expects a decision on Snowden's asylum request 'soon', although the Federal Migration Service has up to three months to decide. Temporary asylum differs from political asylum, which Kucherena said requires a decree from President Vladimir Putin. 'If we are talking about temporary asylum, then this is an issue not for the president but for the Federal Migration Service,' said Putin's spokesman, Dmitry Peskov. Putin has rejected U.S. requests to send Snowden back but stated he doesn't want Snowden to damage relations with Washington. Putin described Snowden's arrival as an unwelcome gift from the United States, stating Snowden intended only to transit through Moscow, but the U.S. intimidated other countries into refusing him, blocking his further travel. Snowden previously sought Russian asylum, which Putin said would be granted only if he stopped leaking information. Snowden withdrew the bid, according to the Kremlin. During Friday's meeting, Snowden argued he hadn't harmed U.S. interests and doesn't intend to. Putin didn't clarify if that would be sufficient grounds for asylum, adding that Snowden apparently doesn't want to stay in Russia permanently. Snowden is a propaganda tool for Putin, who accuses the U.S. government of hypocrisy regarding rights and freedoms. Putin has twice stated that Snowden must cease activities 'aimed at harming our American partners' if he wants political asylum in Russia, but it's unclear if the condition applies to temporary asylum as well. Temporary asylum is granted by the FMS, but Putin is expected to make the final decision, despite his attempts to distance himself from Snowden's situation. Putin hopes Snowden will leave soon but left the door open for granting asylum, seeing signs Snowden is moving toward meeting his conditions. Temporary asylum can be granted for up to a year, with possible extensions. U.S. Deputy Secretary of State William Burns criticized China for not extraditing Snowden when he was in Hong Kong.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- The grounding of Boeing Dreamliner 787s entered its second week, with the company and investigators working non-stop in the United States and Japan to pinpoint the fire risk in the aircraft's electrical system. U.S. aviation authorities are evaluating data but have not yet determined the cause of a battery fire on one Dreamliner and the reason behind a related incident on another plane. These incidents prompted regulators worldwide to ground the $200 million wide-body aircraft until further notice. With batteries and related components under microscopic examination and a new round of testing underway this week at manufacturing facilities, U.S. government officials at the center of the issue expressed their commitment to finding the root cause. However, they also emphasized that it was crucial to allow experts to conduct a thorough investigation and recertify the plane as safe before lifting the grounding order. 'We don't know what is causing these incidents yet,' Federal Aviation Administration chief Michael Huerta told reporters at an industry event in Washington on Wednesday. 'We need to let them finish their work,' Transportation Secretary Ray LaHood said at the same event. 'These are expert people. They'll get to the bottom of it, and then we'll let you all know what they find out,' LaHood said. Experts: A quick fix for the Dreamliner looks less likely. Boeing said in a statement that its technical experts are working 'around the clock' and are focused on 'resolving the issue' and returning the 787 to service. 'We are working tirelessly on this issue in cooperation with our customers and the appropriate regulatory and investigative authorities. The company is eager to see both investigative groups continue their efforts, determine the cause of these events, and support their thorough resolution,' said company spokesman Marc Birtel. A battery-related fire in the underbelly of an empty Japan Airlines 787 on the tarmac in Boston on January 7 triggered an FAA review of the aircraft, though regulators initially deemed the plane safe to fly. The FAA then grounded the fleet on January 16 after an emergency landing by an All Nippon Airways flight in Japan that was prompted by a battery alarm and a report of a burning smell. Analysis of a flight recorder from that plane showed that a lithium-ion battery experienced a sudden drop in voltage and was not overcharged, the Japan Transport Safety Board said Wednesday. Opinion: How Boeing can bounce back from Dreamliner problems. The agency is still investigating the cause of the battery's sharp voltage drop, Norihito Goto, its chairman, said at a news conference. GS Yuasa, the battery's manufacturer, is now disassembling the device for detailed examination. The Japanese findings follow the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board's statement over the weekend that the battery in the Boston fire had not been overcharged. This eliminates a relatively simple potential cause and adds complexity to the investigation. Additional details released by the safety board indicated that all eight cells of the lithium-ion battery involved in the Boston 787 fire showed varying degrees of thermal damage. Investigators scanned and dismantled six of them to expose electrodes for microscopic examination. These batteries power electrical systems, especially when the plane's engines are idle. Dreamliner woes explained. The U.S. safety board also oversaw a series of new tests on battery systems and related components with manufacturers on Tuesday in Arizona. In Washington on Wednesday, U.S. officials were asked about the timing of the unusual order to ground a fleet of planes. 'On the day we said the planes were safe, they were. On the day we announced that there was another incident, and we were grounding the plane, we felt this was the time to ground the planes,' LaHood said. Huerta explained that the second incident occurred during a flight. 'And that for us was an important consideration, where we needed to identify what was causing these power- and battery-related incidents,' he said. The FAA order applied directly to the six Dreamliners operated by United Airlines, the only ones flown by U.S. carriers. However, its directive was adopted by aviation authorities globally and requires that the planes be deemed safe before they fly again. Although there are only 50 wide-body Dreamliners in service, there are several hundred on order. The world's largest aircraft manufacturer has made a significant investment in the most technologically advanced airliner. The 787 is highly touted for its mostly lightweight carbon fiber construction, which airlines expect will help them save billions in fuel costs on long-haul routes. Its cockpit design and cabin appointments are state-of-the-art. The high level of attention and widespread concern about its problems and image are partly due to the Dreamliner's difficult development. The 787 program at Boeing was plagued by cost overruns and production delays. The first one flew commercially last year. Why Dreamliner batteries worry experts. CNN's Junko Ogura in Tokyo contributed to this report.
translated_content: Washington (CNN) -- Prizemljenje Boeingovih Dreamlinera 787 ušlo je u drugi tjedan, dok tvrtka i istražitelji neprekidno rade u Sjedinjenim Državama i Japanu kako bi utvrdili uzrok rizika od požara u električnom sustavu zrakoplova. Američke zrakoplovne vlasti procjenjuju podatke, ali još nisu utvrdile uzrok požara baterije na jednom Dreamlineru ni razlog povezanog incidenta na drugom zrakoplovu. Ti su incidenti potaknuli regulatore diljem svijeta da prizemlje širokotrupni zrakoplov vrijedan 200 milijuna dolara do daljnjega. S baterijama i povezanim komponentama pod mikroskopskim pregledom te novim krugom testiranja koji je u tijeku ovaj tjedan u proizvodnim pogonima, američki vladini dužnosnici u središtu problema izrazili su svoju predanost pronalasku glavnog uzroka. Međutim, također su naglasili da je ključno dopustiti stručnjacima da provedu temeljitu istragu i ponovno certificiraju zrakoplov kao siguran prije ukidanja zabrane letenja. 'Još ne znamo što uzrokuje ove incidente,' rekao je šef Federalne uprave za zrakoplovstvo Michael Huerta novinarima na industrijskom događaju u Washingtonu u srijedu. 'Moramo im dopustiti da završe svoj posao,' rekao je ministar prometa Ray LaHood na istom događaju. 'Ovo su stručni ljudi. Oni će to istražiti do kraja, a onda ćemo vas sve obavijestiti o rezultatima,' rekao je LaHood. Stručnjaci: Brzo rješenje za Dreamliner izgleda sve manje vjerojatno. Boeing je u izjavi rekao da njegovi tehnički stručnjaci rade 'danonoćno' i usredotočeni su na 'rješavanje problema' i povratak 787 u promet. 'Neprekidno radimo na ovom problemu u suradnji s našim klijentima i odgovarajućim regulatornim i istražnim tijelima. Tvrtka želi da obje istražne skupine nastave sa svojim naporima, utvrde uzrok ovih događaja i podrže njihovo temeljito rješavanje,' rekao je glasnogovornik tvrtke Marc Birtel. Požar povezan s baterijom u podvozju praznog zrakoplova Japan Airlinesa 787 na pisti u Bostonu 7. siječnja pokrenuo je pregled zrakoplova od strane FAA-e, iako su regulatori u početku smatrali da je zrakoplov siguran za letenje. FAA je zatim prizemljila zrakoplove 16. siječnja nakon prisilnog slijetanja zrakoplova All Nippon Airwaysa u Japanu, do kojeg je došlo zbog alarma za bateriju i izvješća o mirisu paljevine. Analiza snimača leta s tog zrakoplova pokazala je da je litij-ionska baterija naglo izgubila napon i da nije bila prekomjerno napunjena, objavio je u srijedu Japanski odbor za sigurnost prometa. Mišljenje: Kako se Boeing može oporaviti od problema s Dreamlinerom. Agencija još uvijek istražuje uzrok naglog pada napona baterije, rekao je na konferenciji za novinare Norihito Goto, njezin predsjednik. GS Yuasa, proizvođač baterije, sada rastavlja uređaj radi detaljnog pregleda. Japanski nalazi uslijedili su nakon izjave američkog Nacionalnog odbora za sigurnost prometa tijekom vikenda da baterija u požaru u Bostonu nije bila prekomjerno napunjena. To eliminira relativno jednostavan potencijalni uzrok i povećava složenost istrage. Dodatni detalji koje je objavio odbor pokazali su da svih osam ćelija litij-ionske baterije u požaru zrakoplova Boeing 787 u Bostonu pokazuju različite stupnjeve toplinskog oštećenja. Istražitelji su skenirali i rastavili šest njih kako bi otkrili elektrode za mikroskopski pregled. Ove baterije napajaju električne sustave, posebice kada motori zrakoplova ne rade. Objašnjeni problemi s Dreamlinerom. Američki odbor za sigurnost također je nadgledao niz novih testova na sustavima baterija i povezanim komponentama s proizvođačima u utorak u Arizoni. U Washingtonu su u srijedu američki dužnosnici upitani o vremenu donošenja neobične odluke o prizemljenju flote zrakoplova. 'Na dan kad smo rekli da su zrakoplovi sigurni, bili su. Na dan kad smo objavili da je došlo do još jednog incidenta i da prizemljujemo zrakoplove, smatrali smo da je vrijeme za to,' rekao je LaHood. Huerta je objasnio da se drugi incident dogodio tijekom leta. 'I to nam je bilo važno, jer smo morali utvrditi uzrok tih incidenata povezanih s napajanjem i baterijama,' rekao je. Odluka FAA-e izravno se odnosila na šest Dreamlinera kojima upravlja United Airlines, jedini američki prijevoznik koji ih koristi. Međutim, njihovu su direktivu prihvatile zrakoplovne vlasti diljem svijeta, i zahtijeva da se zrakoplovi proglase sigurnima prije ponovnog polijetanja. Iako je u prometu samo 50 širokotrupnih Dreamlinera, u narudžbi ih je nekoliko stotina. Najveći svjetski proizvođač zrakoplova uložio je značajna sredstva u taj tehnološki najnapredniji zrakoplov. Model 787 se hvali zbog pretežno lagane konstrukcije od karbonskih vlakana, za koju zrakoplovne tvrtke očekuju da će im pomoći uštedjeti milijarde na troškovima goriva na dugim relacijama. Njegov dizajn kokpita i kabine su vrhunski. Velika pozornost i raširena zabrinutost zbog njegovih problema i imidža djelomično su posljedica otežanog razvoja Dreamlinera. Program 787 u Boeingu bio je opterećen prekoračenjima troškova i kašnjenjima u proizvodnji. Prvi je počeo letjeti u komercijalnom prometu prošle godine. Zašto baterije Dreamlinera brinu stručnjake. Junko Ogura s CNN-a iz Tokija pridonijela je ovom izvješću.

article_content: Threads is intensifying its competition with X, previously known as Twitter, by introducing poll and GIF functionalities this Thursday. These additions, widely recognized on X, represent the latest in a series of changes implemented by Meta's CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, on the Threads platform in recent weeks. Zuckerberg conveyed his enthusiasm for these novel features in a Threads announcement on Thursday, accompanied by a GIF featuring UFC's Bruce Buffer, captioning it: 'How I feel about polls and GIFs rolling out today on Threads.' He also initiated a separate poll, exclusively accessible via the mobile application and not the website, offering users three options for real-time voting. This feature operates similarly to polls on Instagram Stories, with the added functionality of sending notifications to users who participated in the poll upon its conclusion. The introduction of GIF and poll options follows a string of recent updates to Threads, including a web-based version, an edit button, profile switching, likes, a chronological feed, and other enhancements. These additions to Threads come after Zuckerberg informed investors during a Wednesday earnings call that he anticipates the app will reach one billion users. This projection might seem ambitious, considering Threads currently has fewer than 100 million monthly active users. However, Zuckerberg asserts that, at the current rate of growth, achieving this user base within a few years is a realistic expectation. 'We are now three months into this, and I am very pleased with the progress,' Zuckerberg stated during the call. 'I have long believed that there should be a widely used public conversation app fostering a more positive environment. If we continue our efforts over the next few years, I am confident we have a strong chance of realizing our vision.' Threads experienced a surge in popularity following its initial launch in June, attracting over one million active users in the first week. However, the app quickly lost traction, with daily active users declining by over 80% in early August. During the Q2 earnings call, Zuckerberg noted to investors that a higher-than-expected number of individuals were returning to Threads daily. He emphasized that the current focus is on user retention and refining the fundamental aspects of the platform before attempting to increase user acquisition.

Zuckerberg je izrazio svoj entuzijazam za ove nove značajke u objavi na Threadsu u četvrtak, popraćen GIF-om s Bruceom Bufferom iz UFC-a, uz natpis: 'Kako se osjećam zbog uvođenja anketa i GIF-ova danas na Threadsu.' Također je pokrenuo zasebnu anketu, dostupnu isključivo putem mobilne aplikacije, a ne web stranice, nudeći korisnicima tri opcije za glasanje u stvarnom vremenu. Threads je doživio porast popularnosti nakon svog početnog lansiranja u lipnju, privukavši preko milijun aktivnih korisnika u prvom tjednu. Međutim, aplikacija je brzo izgubila na snazi, a dnevni aktivni korisnici smanjili su se za više od 80% početkom kolovoza. Tijekom poziva o zaradi u drugom tromjesečju, Zuckerberg je investitorima napomenuo da se više ljudi nego što se očekivalo svakodnevno vraća na Threads. article_content: Dozens of tourists have fallen ill with similar symptoms while traveling to a popular holiday destination. En route to the Blue Mountains in NSW, a number of the 25 Japanese tourists on the same tour bus began experiencing symptoms of food poisoning. Most of the affected individuals were suffering from diarrhea and vomiting, according to reports from The Sydney Morning Herald. Earlier that day, they had stopped in Brisbane and shared a meal. Dozens of Japanese tourists on a tour bus experienced a gastrointestinal illness on Monday and Tuesday. Paramedics were dispatched to a street in Chipping Norton to assess the affected tourists. Some tourists required ambulance transport to the hospital. Shortly after 1pm on Monday, paramedics were called to Governor Macquarie Drive in Chipping Norton, as the tourists were reportedly heading towards Katoomba in the Blue Mountains. Images depict medical personnel in protective gear assessing the ill tourists, checking vital signs and other symptoms. Wearing masks and protective equipment, they examined individuals roadside before transporting some by ambulance. Others who were less severely affected disembarked from the bus and sat nearby, wearing face masks. A spokeswoman for the South-West Sydney Local Health District stated that the patients exhibited signs consistent with food poisoning. Four individuals were admitted to Liverpool Hospital and are currently in stable condition. Initially, one tourist was isolated in the bathroom of the Murray coach the group was traveling in, as reported by a witness, before more passengers became ill. Michael Akkari stated that the patients were transported to the hospital, with the coach being used as a 'quarantine capsule'. 'Those less affected sat on the grass beside the bus. They were visibly concerned, but there was also some laughter,' he said. A spokeswoman for the South-West Sydney Local Health District confirmed to Daily Mail Australia that they were taken to Liverpool Hospital, where four individuals were admitted. She confirmed that all were in a stable condition and displayed symptoms consistent with food poisoning. Another spokesman clarified to The Sydney Morning Herald that 'this is definitely not a case of Ebola'.

article_content: An Australian camera crew captured poignant footage illustrating the devastating impact of the Ebola virus in Sierra Leone, one of the regions hardest hit. The journalists, who were the last camera crew present before a government lockdown forced their departure, documented the experiences of Australian volunteers collaborating with infected individuals and their families at an emergency center near the Liberian and Guinean borders. Since the outbreak began in March of this year, the Ebola virus has claimed over 1,427 lives in West Africa, according to the World Health Organisation. This number is projected to surpass the total fatalities recorded in outbreaks between 1976 and 2012, which amounted to 1,590. The Australian team meticulously documented conditions at an Ebola crisis coordination center in Kailahun, Sierra Leone. The disease is highly contagious, lacks a cure, and has a 90 percent fatality rate, resulting in an agonizing death. Malcolm Hugo, an Australian psychologist, is among the healthcare professionals stationed at the Kailahun crisis coordination center, working alongside organizations such as the International Red Cross, Medecins Sans Frontieres, and the World Health Organisation. The center features an isolation ward where patients struggle through the 21-day illness cycle, with a 60% mortality rate. Dr. Hugo provides counseling to Ebola patients, their families, and medical staff. He is also tasked with finding foster homes for children orphaned by the virus. He described the immense difficulty of separating children from potentially infected mothers. ‘It’s always a heartbreaking moment to inform a parent that separation is in the child's best interest. In two instances, mothers were breastfeeding, making it extremely difficult to convince them to relinquish their children. Finding a safe environment for the child then becomes a challenge,’ Dr. Hugo explained. 'People are fearful, and those who have been present here encounter significant stigma and marginalization upon returning home.' 'Providing accurate and timely information to the community is crucial, especially given the suddenness of the epidemic and its catastrophic effects on small communities where entire families have perished.' Dr. Richard Broome, a NSW Public Health physician who assessed the strategy's effectiveness at the coordination center, highlighted the conflict between local customs and emergency response efforts. 'The environments in which people live are critically important to understanding the spread of this outbreak,' Dr. Broome stated. 'Many people hold beliefs in black magic and traditional practices, often attributing events to witchcraft and curses. These beliefs, combined with a disease like Ebola, can lead to explosive outbreaks.’ Despite the tragedy, there are stories of extraordinary survival, including a two-and-a-half-year-old girl who lost 17 family members to Ebola but ultimately overcame the illness. The full story, 'EBOLA – Into the Hot Zone', will be broadcast on ABC's Foreign Correspondent on Tuesday at 8pm.

Novinari, koji su bili posljednja snimateljska ekipa prisutna prije nego što ih je vladino zatvaranje prisililo na odlazak, dokumentirali su iskustva australskih volontera koji surađuju sa zaraženim osobama i njihovim obiteljima u hitnom centru u blizini liberijske i gvinejske granice. Od početka epidemije u ožujku ove godine, virus ebole odnio je više od 1427 života u zapadnoj Africi, prema podacima Svjetske zdravstvene organizacije. Očekuje se da će ovaj broj premašiti ukupan broj smrtnih slučajeva zabilježenih u epidemijama između 1976. i 2012. godine, koji je iznosio 1590. Australski tim je pomno dokumentirao uvjete u kriznom koordinacijskom centru za ebolu u Kailahunu, Sijera Leone. Bolest je vrlo zarazna, nema lijeka i ima stopu smrtnosti od 90 posto, što rezultira agonizirajućom smrću. Malcolm Hugo, australski psiholog, jedan je od zdravstvenih radnika smještenih u kriznom koordinacijskom centru u Kailahunu, radeći zajedno s organizacijama kao što su Međunarodni Crveni križ, Liječnici bez granica i Svjetska zdravstvena organizacija. Centar ima izolacijski odjel u kojem se pacijenti bore tijekom 21-dnevnog ciklusa bolesti, uz stopu smrtnosti od 60%. Dr. Hugo pruža savjetovanje pacijentima oboljelima od ebole, njihovim obiteljima i medicinskom osoblju. Također je zadužen za pronalaženje udomiteljskih obitelji za djecu koja su ostala bez roditelja zbog virusa. Opisao je ogromnu poteškoću odvajanja djece od potencijalno zaraženih majki. ‘Uvijek je srceparajući trenutak obavijestiti roditelja da je odvajanje u najboljem interesu djeteta. U dva slučaja, majke su dojile, što je izuzetno otežavalo uvjeriti ih da se odreknu svoje djece. Pronalaženje sigurnog okruženja za dijete tada postaje izazov,’ objasnio je dr. Hugo. ‘Ljudi se boje, a oni koji su bili ovdje suočavaju se sa značajnom stigmom i marginalizacijom po povratku kući.’ ‘Pružanje točnih i pravodobnih informacija zajednici je ključno, posebno s obzirom na iznenadnost epidemije i njezine katastrofalne učinke na male zajednice u kojima su cijele obitelji nestale.’ Dr. Richard Broome, liječnik javnog zdravstva iz NSW-a koji je procijenio učinkovitost strategije u koordinacijskom centru, istaknuo je sukob između lokalnih običaja i napora za odgovor na hitne situacije. ‘Okruženja u kojima ljudi žive od kritične su važnosti za razumijevanje širenja ove epidemije,’ izjavio je dr. Broome. ‘Mnogi ljudi vjeruju u crnu magiju i tradicionalne prakse, često pripisujući događaje vještičarstvu i kletvama. Ta uvjerenja, u kombinaciji s bolešću poput ebole, mogu dovesti do eksplozivnih epidemija.’ Unatoč tragediji, postoje priče o izvanrednom preživljavanju, uključujući dvogodišnju djevojčicu koja je izgubila 17 članova obitelji zbog ebole, ali je na kraju preboljela bolest. Cijela priča, 'EBOLA – U žarištu', bit će emitirana na ABC-jevom Foreign Correspondent u utorak u 20 sati.

article_content: Recently, Belgian artist Jan Fabre sparked widespread outrage for a performance at Antwerp City Hall, Belgium, where he threw several cats into the air. The vulnerable animals reportedly screamed in distress before landing on a flight of stairs that had some padding. Fabre's actions have led to considerable backlash; he has received approximately 20,000 complaints and has been physically assaulted on seven occasions, according to reports. The performance video ignited a torrent of criticism online. The Belgian newspaper La Libre Belgique noted the large volume of complaints received by Fabre. Adding to his troubles, Antwerp's deputy mayor for animal welfare and the Global Action in the Interest of Animals have formally protested Fabre's actions. In response, Fabre expressed regret on Flemish TV, saying he was sorry the cats 'landed badly' and that he didn't intend to harm them. He later suggested on a French-language station that the coverage of his cat-throwing performance was overly dramatized.

article_content: Don't expect Barry Geraghty to become envious of his colleagues' rides anytime soon – there's no need. The 35-year-old Irishman is expected to ride his 2013 Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Bobs Worth, King George VI Chase favourite Simonsig, and the recovering 2013 Champion Chase winner Sprinter Sacre in the coming weeks. Geraghty is also enthusiastic about future talent. Barry Geraghty won the Doom Bar Sefton Novices Hurdle with Beat That. Geraghty is looking ahead to racing up-and-coming horses including Beat That and Vaniteux. That’s why missing the ride on Jezki, his Champion Hurdle winner in March, for its return to action against Hurricane Fly in Saturday's Morgiana Hurdle at Punchestown, and More Of That, his World Hurdle winner, in the Long Distance Hurdle at Newbury later this month, will not cause any frustration. Geraghty said: ‘I can’t say I am overly envious of anyone. I had a great ride from More Of That and Jezki last season. They are two horses you’d like to ride, but I hope to have two young horses step up and challenge them in Beat That and Vaniteux. ‘Beat That was underdeveloped last year but still managed to win at Punchestown and Aintree. He should improve a lot physically. The hope is that he will become a World Hurdle contender. More Of That sets the standard, but he should have a chance.’ Geraghty celebrates after winning the Ladbrokes World Hurdle at Cheltenham with More Of That. The Irish jockey races to victory on Jezki at the Champion Hurdle at Cheltenham. Geraghty’s aspirations for Vaniteux, who finished third in the Supreme Novices’ Hurdle in March, will be tested when he carries top weight of 11st 12lb in tomorrow’s Greatwood Hurdle. Geraghty said: ‘Even though he has top weight, his handicap mark is reasonable. He has pace but he doesn’t lack physique – he is very strong.’ Geraghty rides Oscar Whisky for his boss Nicky Henderson in Saturday afternoon’s Paddy Power Gold Cup, a race he won in 2002 on Cyfor Malta. Geraghty (C) leads eventual winner Parlour Games to victory at the Hyde Novices’ Hurdle. The three-time Grade One winner has not yet matched his best hurdles form when chasing, but Geraghty feels he knows the key. The rider said: ‘The big thing is to get him into a rhythm jumping. If he does, he has a big chance.’ Geraghty’s Open Meeting got off to a good start on Friday, easily winning the Grade Two Hyde Novices’ Hurdle on John Ferguson-trained 10-1 Parlour Games. The six-year-old, now at the same odds for the Neptune Investment Novices’ Hurdle at the Festival in March, showed a classy turn of foot, which isn't surprising given he won the 2011 Melrose Stakes at York and his dam is the 2000 Irish Oaks winner Petrushka. The BHA and Cheltenham will not change the start time of the Paddy Power Gold Cup, despite fears it could be disrupted by low sunlight. Only 10 of the 16 obstacles were jumped in Friday's novices’ chase won by Champagne West, which started at 2.25pm. Today’s race is scheduled for 2.30pm. Spokesman Robin Mounsey said the chance of a problem was ‘low risk,’ but the BHA will hope to avoid an embarrassing hat-trick. Two weeks ago, the Charlie Hall Chase at Wetherby was run over the wrong distance. Last week’s Badger Beer Chase at Wincanton was ‘won’ by an ineligible entry, The Young Master, who was subsequently disqualified.

article_content: Conservationists have warned that European and African vultures could become extinct within a generation if no action is taken to save them. The concern over vultures in Europe and Africa arises after populations plummeted by more than 99% in Asia. These birds play a crucial role as scavengers, cleaning up dead wildlife. The Asian vulture populations were decimated by diclofenac, a veterinary drug used to treat inflammation in livestock. It is lethally toxic to vultures when they ingest it from carcasses, causing a faster decline than the Dodo before its extinction. BirdLife International warns that diclofenac is commercially available in Spain and Italy, both key habitats for vultures in Europe. Vultures in Africa face increasing threats from accidental and deliberate poisoning, persecution for body parts used in traditional medicine, habitat loss, and collisions with power lines, according to BirdLife. BirdLife International warns that three-quarters of vultures in the Old World (Europe, Africa, and Asia) are threatened or near-threatened with extinction. Kariuki Ndanganga, BirdLife Africa’s species programme manager, stated, 'Unless threats are identified and tackled quickly and effectively, vultures in Africa and Europe could face extinction within our lifetime.' Jim Lawrence, BirdLife’s preventing extinctions programme manager, said, 'We know what to do in Europe: ban veterinary diclofenac. We also know what we need to do for Africa: urgently understand fully the threats and extinction risk so we can act quickly, with priority.' The conservation charity is calling for support for its campaign to stop vulture poisoning in a bid to tackle the threats the birds face.

article_content: Diplomatic relations between Turkey and Egypt have deteriorated, leading to a mutual expulsion of ambassadors. Egypt initiated the move, declaring Turkey's ambassador 'persona non grata,' citing Turkish interference in Egyptian internal affairs, according to Anadolu Agency. Turkey retaliated by downgrading diplomatic ties and mirroring the expulsion. Cairo had already reduced its diplomatic presence in Turkey and withdrew its ambassador months prior. Observers see this dispute as a sign of an increasingly strained relationship, highlighting Turkey's 'growing isolation' in the region. The souring of relations began after the Egyptian military removed President Mohamed Morsy, who had close affiliations with Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan and his AKP party. Following Morsy's removal, Egypt outlawed the Muslim Brotherhood and seized its assets. Erdogan, once warmly welcomed in Cairo, has been critical of the post-Morsy leadership in Egypt. Fadi Hakura of Chatham House suggested that these events underscore Turkey's increasing isolation, with a perception that Turkey's foreign policy is based on sectarian priorities. Hakura added that Turkey faces strained relations with numerous countries, including Israel, Iran, Syria, Iraq, Gulf Arab states, Morocco, Algeria, Egypt, and Jordan. Furthermore, he noted that President Obama is reportedly dissatisfied with Turkey's foreign policy, evidenced by a lack of communication between the two leaders. While the Cairo-Ankara tensions may not drastically affect Turkish-U.S. relations, Hakura believes they diminish Turkey's significance in U.S. foreign policy considerations. This contrasts with 2012, when Erdogan presented Turkey as a role model for democratic Islamist movements. Suat Kiniklioglu, a former AKP lawmaker, cautioned that Turkey needs to reassess its foreign policy in the Middle East after recent setbacks. He emphasized the importance of calibrating the approach towards Cairo, highlighting that the Arab Spring, the Syrian civil war, and the Egyptian coup have significantly altered Turkey's regional standing.

article_content: Terrence Nyahwa, a 17-year-old schoolboy and rugby enthusiast, has become the youngest individual in the UK to undergo keyhole surgery for the removal of a heart growth. Previously, this type of operation necessitated cutting into the breastbone, a significantly invasive procedure requiring several months for recovery. This traditional approach often left the operation site vulnerable, precluding a return to high-impact sports such as rugby. In contrast, surgeons made only two small incisions and employed a specialized wire-cage device to extract the growth from Terrence Nyahwa’s heart. This innovative keyhole approach offers a swift recovery, minimizes infection risk, and eliminates the need for a large scar. Cardiac tumors pose a substantial risk due to the potential for fragments to detach and circulate throughout the body. Should these fragments reach the brain or lungs, they could induce a stroke or heart failure. Ranjit Deshpande, who spearheaded the surgical team at King’s College Hospital in Camberwell, South London, emphasized, ‘We not only saved Terrence’s life but also preserved his aspirations of playing rugby.’ Deshpande added, ‘Without this advanced technique, Terrence would have been unable to return to the field, which can have a profound psychological impact on a young person.’ Terrence had been experiencing chest discomfort and breathlessness during sports activities for several months. Subsequent hospital evaluations revealed the presence of a benign tumor, leading to surgery within 48 hours. Initially, Terrence's heart was connected to a bypass machine, as operating on a beating heart carries excessive risk. Subsequently, surgeons used a scalpel to create a 0.2-inch incision between his ribs, inserting a long, flexible tube equipped with a miniature high-definition camera. The camera was strategically positioned inside the heart, providing clinicians with a clear visual assessment of the tumor. A second incision was then made above the first, facilitating the insertion of a long scalpel into the right chamber of Terrence’s heart. Notably, the heart itself was not cut; instead, the scalpel passed through a natural opening. The wire cage, referred to as a ‘snare,’ was introduced through the same opening. The snare expands like a flower and then contracts around the tumor, securing it to prevent displacement during surgical removal. Once detached from the heart, the grape-sized tumor was carefully extracted from Terrence’s body using the snare. Remarkably, Terrence was walking again within a day and discharged home within a week. During his first game back with Old Elthamians RFC, he scored a try and now aims to pursue a professional rugby career. ‘This means the world to me, and I feel incredibly fortunate to be back on the field,’ Terrence stated. ‘Previously, I could only play for about ten minutes, but now my stamina has returned. Plus, I don’t have a significant scar on my chest.’ Terrence discovered his heart condition while playing rugby due to experiencing shortness of breath.
translated_content: Terrence Nyahwa, 17-godišnji učenik i ljubitelj ragbija, postao je najmlađa osoba u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu koja je podvrgnuta operaciji srca metodom ključanice radi uklanjanja izrasline. Prethodno je ova vrsta operacije zahtijevala rezanje prsne kosti, što je znatno invazivniji postupak koji zahtijeva nekoliko mjeseci oporavka. Ovaj tradicionalni pristup često je ostavljao mjesto operacije osjetljivim, isključujući povratak sportovima s visokim utjecajem kao što je ragbi. Nasuprot tome, kirurzi su napravili samo dva mala reza i upotrijebili specijalizirani uređaj sa žičanim kavezom za vađenje izrasline iz srca Terrencea Nyahwe. Ovaj inovativni pristup ključanice nudi brz oporavak, minimalizira rizik od infekcije i uklanja potrebu za velikim ožiljkom. Srčani tumori predstavljaju znatan rizik zbog mogućnosti odvajanja fragmenata i cirkuliranja po cijelom tijelu. Ako ti fragmenti dospiju do mozga ili pluća, mogu izazvati moždani udar ili zatajenje srca. Ranjit Deshpande, koji je predvodio kirurški tim u bolnici King's College u Camberwellu, Južni London, naglasio je: 'Ne samo da smo spasili Terrenceov život, već smo i očuvali njegove težnje da igra ragbi.' Deshpande je dodao: 'Bez ove napredne tehnike, Terrence se ne bi mogao vratiti na teren, što može imati dubok psihološki utjecaj na mladu osobu.' Terrence je nekoliko mjeseci osjećao nelagodu u prsima i nedostatak daha tijekom sportskih aktivnosti. Naknadne bolničke pretrage otkrile su prisutnost benignog tumora, što je dovelo do operacije u roku od 48 sati. U početku je Terrenceovo srce bilo spojeno na stroj za premosnicu, jer je operacija na srcu koje kuca previše rizična. Nakon toga, kirurzi su upotrijebili skalpel za stvaranje reza od 0,2 inča između njegovih rebara, umetnuvši dugu, fleksibilnu cijev opremljenu minijaturnom kamerom visoke razlučivosti. Kamera je bila strateški postavljena unutar srca, pružajući liječnicima jasan vizualni pregled tumora. Zatim je napravljen drugi rez iznad prvog, olakšavajući umetanje dugog skalpela u desnu komoru Terrenceova srca. Valja napomenuti da srce nije bilo prerezano; umjesto toga, skalpel je prošao kroz prirodni otvor. Žičani kavez, koji se naziva 'zamka', uveden je kroz isti otvor. Zamka se širi poput cvijeta, a zatim se skuplja oko tumora, osiguravajući ga kako bi se spriječilo njegovo pomicanje tijekom kirurškog uklanjanja. Nakon što se odvojio od srca, tumor veličine grožđa pažljivo je izvađen iz Terrenceova tijela pomoću zamke. Zapanjujuće, Terrence je ponovno hodao u roku od jednog dana, a otpušten je kući u roku od tjedan dana. Tijekom svoje prve utakmice s Old Elthamians RFC, postigao je polaganje i sada ima za cilj nastaviti profesionalnu ragbi karijeru. 'Ovo mi znači cijeli svijet i osjećam se nevjerojatno sretnim što sam se vratio na teren', izjavio je Terrence. 'Prije sam mogao igrati samo desetak minuta, ali sada mi se vratila izdržljivost. Osim toga, nemam veliki ožiljak na prsima.' Terrence je otkrio svoje srčano stanje igrajući ragbi zbog osjećaja nedostatka daha.

article_content: In Nigeria's Borno state, a series of assaults by Boko Haram on four villages have led to a tragic loss of life. According to a government representative, over 50 individuals were killed, and more than 300 buildings—including five churches—were demolished. On Sunday, armed men riding motorcycles attacked the Christian communities of Kwada, Ngurojina, Karagau, and Kautikari, which are located close to Chibok. Chibok is known as the site where over 200 schoolgirls were kidnapped on April 14. The assailants opened fire on locals and launched explosives at residences and religious buildings. Kwada suffered the most damage; attackers completely destroyed the village and its five churches during a five-hour assault. A senior official from the Borno state government reported that the Boko Haram insurgents' attacks resulted in the deaths of 54 people and the destruction of over 300 homes. The official chose to remain anonymous due to lack of authorization to release the death toll. Thirty-six bodies were recovered in Kwada, making it the most severely impacted location, according to the official. Search teams scoured the area surrounding the villages, situated within 10 kilometers (6 miles) of Chibok, from late Sunday through Monday, seeking additional casualties. Residents reported that armed men pursued and fatally shot fleeing individuals. According to a community leader in Chibok, who requested anonymity for fear of Boko Haram retaliation, 47 bodies had been discovered by Monday morning, and search teams were still looking for more. According to a Christian priest in Chibok, 30 bodies were found on Sunday. Barnabas Tanko, a member of a local defense group in Kwada, stated that the attackers encountered resistance in Kautikari, resulting in the deaths of six of them. Residents attributed the significant number of deaths and widespread destruction of homes to the delayed military response. They claim the attackers had five hours to cause destruction before a military jet finally arrived. Tanko reported that the attacks began around 8 a.m. local time and lasted until 1 p.m. without any military intervention. He also stated that upon spotting the fighter jet, the attackers retreated into the bush. A Nigerian government spokesperson stated that the military and air force were deployed to the area but arrived 'a bit late.' Residents disputed the claim, calling it untrue.

U nedjelju su naoružani ljudi na motociklima napali kršćanska sela Kwada, Ngurojina, Karagau i Kautikari, koja se nalaze u blizini Chiboka. Chibok je poznat kao mjesto gdje je 14. travnja oteto više od 200 učenica. Napadači su otvorili vatru na mještane i bacali eksploziv na kuće i vjerske objekte. Kwada je pretrpjela najveću štetu; napadači su potpuno uništili selo i njegovih pet crkava tijekom petosatnog napada. Visoki dužnosnik vlade države Borno izvijestio je da su napadi pobunjenika Boko Harama rezultirali smrću 54 osobe i uništenjem više od 300 domova.
